Welcome to
Rainbow International School

Educating Students for Success in an Evolving World Technology in Classrooms E-learning resources for better learning & memory Extracurricular Activities Annual events, clubs, exhibitions, music, art & organic farming Personality Development Attention to etiquette, team work & self-confidence Philosophy of Sensitivity Incorporating social & environmental consciousness

Philosophy of Sensitivity

Incorporating social & environmental awareness

Personality Development

Being mindful of etiquette, teamwork & self-confidence

Let’s Discover the Rainbow!

An Institute committed to Educating, Strengthening, Nurturing Students and empowering all learners.

Awards & Accomplishments

Accolades earned by Rainbow International School for being one of the most promising schools of the decade in the educational sphere.

Amenities & Facilities

We offer globally recognized educational resources and state-of-the-art facilities that make Rainbow International School unparalleled.

Student Achievements

At Rainbow, Student Accomplishments are acknowledged and honored. Here you can view the list of our Best Achievers.

Safety &
Security

Student safety & well-being is our top-most priority and we ensure it is safeguarded through the stringent security measures of modern times.

What Parent's Speak

Check Parents’ Review on Rainbow International School Services Good school, caring teachers, extremely supportive staff who put in a lot of effort and the experience has been good for us. It’s always a partnership between Institutions and parents to give the best to children and has therefore worked well for us. keep up the good work teachers and thank you. Mohan Ramaswamy I will recommend this school as this school given up so much in terms of values and well organized.. It was first time I sent my daughter for outstation picnic and beyond expectations it was really very well organized and communication between teachers and parents are always welcome… Management and teachers give ears to share parents point of view!! Ruchi Verma We are very Happy with the school… authorities and the management. Teachers are also nice n ensure all the kids get the required attention. Extra curricular activities are also looked after and appreciated. Ratish Pradhan A Progressive School with Very Supportive Management. Teachers & Support staff are very cooperative. Most Importantly, even if there are any issues School always puts forward an issue resolving approach Alok Srivastava Highly recommended school. Most lively atmosphere. The warmth in the school makes every child comfortable. Lot of extra efforts taken by the management to introduce practical activities for students to get exposed to real challenges in real life. Hygiene their forte .. Undoubtedly the best school in Thane. Anuja Pradhan The study pattern in rainbow is very well balanced between books & extra activity, I love to here from my 8 yrs son when he explains me everything he learnt this means he is enjoying which was not the case one year back when he was in another school. Great going rainbow teachers keep it up. Chandrasekhar Ella Great school… standard of teaching is of very high level…also give preference to personality development… sports day.. picnic… annual day… every event was owsome… well organised & very nicely presented and executed. Hemalata Nigudkar A school where the teachers care for the students like parents do… the place where every child gets equal opportunity & blossoms into a better version of themselves. Students love to come to school as there is never a dull moment… fun & learning go hand in hand 👍🏻👍🏻 Amrapali Koonapareddy My daughter Aarya goes to this school, it is a great school with amazing infrastructure, safety is the most important thing that they have. Teachers are very supportive. The most thing I like that they have their own organic farm where kids learn the things practically. So far very nice experience. My kid enjoy this schooling. Aarya Rahul Desai I would highly recommend Rainbow International School without hesitation. There are so many options locally that it can be overwhelming to choose but RIS gave my child a stellar foundation plus a nurturing environment that made the school an extension of our family. To watch the excellent teachers at Rainbow International School in action is truly a sight! Dhaval Lodaya Went for inquiry session, wonderful infrastructure, strong security arrangement and lovely people to guide. Surely going ahead for admissions. Would strong recommend Rainbow International School. Ravi Thakur Hello…feeling privileged to share my view on this page. Just a word… Fantastic school. The teachers are Professional, caring and well organized.. infrastructure is outstanding. Children grow intellectually as well as in other co Curricular activities… teachers really care & truly want the best for a child… Surabhi Trivedi Rainbow international School nurtures each child’s natural talents & intelligence to help them achieve their full potential, through Academic Excellence, Outstanding coaching for Sports, Best Infrastructure, Personal Attention and Holistic Development. Nikhil Ghavnalkar The school works on nurturing the kids for all-round development & rather than just focusing on academics. Many events are held throughout the year to encourage students to develop their skills in the relevant domain. The school is affiliated with CBSE & maintain the utmost standard of education. Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane. Aabhay Choudhary Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. My son is happy studying in Rainbow International School. My school is in their Anand Nagar Branch. Netra Patil Chatterjee It’s a great educational establishment to entrust your kids too, with an excellent infrastructure and warm-hearted, friendly and cooperative staff. I will recommend Rainbow International School for you kids. Mark D’Souza Previous Next

item.title: RPS-About-us-01
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to Rainbow International School

Founded in April 2009, Rainbow International School has touched the lives of more than 25,000 students ever since.

With One of the Finest Education institute in thane, Rainbow International School has a campus that spans over 3.5 acres. In addition to being a visible landmark, we are enormous in terms of many other factors, such as the 3000 students are been enrolled in two shifts.

Our Teaching methods partners with comfort, colours & technology in our classrooms so that our students learn more effectively and quickly.
We have a diversity of other learning spaces that includes state of an art laboratories, library, multipurpose hall, music room, reading room, infirmary, organic farming area, and an amphitheatre.

Our outdoor spaces for sports activities include - a football field, an adventure sports field, a skating rink, a swimming pool, multipurpose cournts and many more outdoor sporting facilities.

We have been growing in our capacity, in our infrastructure and in terms of ideas to take better care of our students.

Classes

item.content:encoded:
Beyond The Classroom

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | Elementor Single Post #2300 |

Beyond The Classroom

The real aim of education is not only knowledge but also Action. 

We provide rigorous, comprehensive & Cohesive learning. Programme that is designed to meet the Social Physical & Cultural needs of an International student body as well.

Exhibitions :

Annual Science, Math, Social Science, and EVS Exhibition 'IMPULSE' is organized to showcase the organizational abilities, oratory skills and knowledge of the students.

Clubs:

To foster a multi-dimensional personality, students are exposed to various club activities of their choice which include the Health & Wellness Club, Interact Club, Culinary Club, Literary Club, Heritage Club, Science & Maths Club, Eco Club & Cultural Club 

TOURS & VISITS:

To make learning a joyful & hands-on experience. Recreational, Educational & Cultural Tours & Visits are arranged for students.

PROMOTING GREEN:

Students are encouraged to feel the soil and develop a green thumb. They participate in different green activities like sowing seeds in a vegetable garden, planting saplings in a butterfly garden and medicinal patches.

DIGNITY OF LABOUR:

To sensitize & appreciate the merit of every profession & labour, students actively participate in In-House community service programmes.

item.title: chairman message
item.dc:creator: animamax
item.content:encoded:
Chairman’s Note

“Live as if you were to die tomorrow,

Learn as if you were to live forever”

- Mahatma Gandhi

Just like Our Beloved Mahatma Gandhi Ji believed, Learning is essential for an individual’s growth. And when we hear the word Learning, The word Education comes to our mind as they both are co-related.

Education is a joint venture: an association between the school and the home to ensure that children become successful in whatever they choose to pursue. Right education materializes out of co-operation among the learners, mentors, parents and the community.

At Rainbow, you, the parents, play a vital role in our journey towards excellence and your contribution is priceless to us.

I assure you that the entire team of Rainbow International School helps shape each child into an intelligent, skilled and committed Indian citizen with a global perspective. I look forward to your kind association, valuable support and a healthy rapport that shall assist us in the holistic development of each child.

Yours Sincerely,

Mrs Akila Balbale
Chairperson

I look forward to your kind association, valuable support and a healthy rapport that shall assist us in the holistic development of each child.<\/p>

item.title: Sample Page
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:

Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)

...or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://rainbowinternationalschool.in.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane. Aabhay Choudhary Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. item.content:encoded:
About Rainbow

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | About Rainbow |

Welcome to Rainbow International School

Founded in April 2009, Rainbow International School has touched the lives of more than 50,000 students ever since.

Being One of the Finest educational Institutes in Thane, Rainbow International School is considered to have a campus that spans over 3.5 acres. In addition to being a visible landmark, we are also enormous in terms of many other factors, such as the 3000 students are been enrolled in two shifts.

In addition to being synonymous with quality education, We at Rainbow International School are committed to all-around growth in our students. Rainbow allows its students to explore human excellence through competence, conscience, and compassion.

Our Teaching methods integrate comfort, colors, and technology within classrooms, which enables our students not only to learn more effectively but also quickly.

We have a diversity of other learning spaces including state of an art laboratories, a library, a multipurpose hall, a music room, a reading room, an infirmary, an organic farming area, and an amphitheater.

Our outdoor spaces for sports activities include - a football field, an adventure sports field, a skating rink, a swimming pool, multipurpose courts, and many more outdoor sporting facilities.

We have been growing in our capacity, in our infrastructure, and in terms of ideas to take better care of our students.

Classes

Chairperson’s Note

“Live as if you were to die tomorrow,

Learn as if you were to live forever”

- Mahatma Gandhi

Just like Our Beloved Mahatma Gandhi Ji believed, Learning is absolutely essential for an individual’s growth. Thus when we hear the word Learning, The word Education comes to our mind altogether as they both are co-related.

Education is not only a joint venture but an association between the school and the home but also ensures that children become successful in whatever they choose to pursue. Right education materializes out of cooperation among the learners, mentors, parents, and the community.

At Rainbow, you, the parents, play a vital role in our journey towards excellence and your contribution is priceless to us.

I assure you that the entire team of Rainbow International School helps shape each child into an intelligent, skilled, and committed Indian citizen with a global perspective. I look forward to your kind association, valuable support, and a healthy rapport that shall assist us in the holistic development of each child.

Yours Sincerely,

Mrs Akila Balbale
Chairperson

Our Vision & Mission

Contacts
Vision

We recognize the importance of imparting an educational experience that is of international standards which prepares children for global citizenship. We are a school with an Indian mind and with an Indian soul, a school that celebrates the culture of excellence and nurtures values.

We believe that a national curriculum accompanied by values and life skills is an integral factor in the process of internationalization of values because one can only give what one has within.

Mission

To provide a conducive environment for learning that brings out the best in the students and supports their all-round development. To encourage the joy of learning amongst our students by awakening and illuminating their intellect level in multidimensional ways.

We also educate our students to excel as good human beings so that they can contribute to the advancement of society through creative activities and scholarly talent.

The Rainbow Philosophy

Philosophy of Transcending Academic Standards

Knowledge and learning are meaningless without sensitivity. At Rainbow, we help students think about larger scenarios.

These scenarios include a developing consciousness about:

  • SELF
  • WORLD
  • GENDER, and
  • ENVIRONMENT.

The syllabi and the teaching methodology are guided by our commitment to shaping our future generations in a way that they can handle new challenges creatively.

Amenities & Facilities

Nurturing Green Thinking

Students connect with nature & see how life is born when they sow seeds in the garden.

Asserting Dignity of Labour

Students join in-house community service to appreciate the value of all kinds of work.

Developing Personalities

Students learn about etiquette, social behavior, and ethical ways of thinking and responding.

Emphasizing Gender Sensitivity

Students think about ways to overcome bias & discrimination & nurture a positive self-image

Parents Corner

Explore Parent’s Response box down here.

Good school, caring teachers, extremely supportive staff who put in a lot of effort and the experience has been good for us. It’s always a partnership between Institutions and parents to give the best to children and has therefore worked well for us. keep up the good work teachers and thank you. Mohan Ramaswamy I will recommend this school as this school given up so much in terms of values and well organized.. It was first time I sent my daughter for outstation picnic and beyond expectations it was really very well organized and communication between teachers and parents are always welcome… Management and teachers give ears to share parents point of view!! Ruchi Verma We are very Happy with the school… authorities and the management. Teachers are also nice n ensure all the kids get the required attention. Extra curricular activities are also looked after and appreciated. Ratish Pradhan A Progressive School with Very Supportive Management. Teachers & Support staff are very cooperative. Most Importantly, even if there are any issues School always puts forward an issue resolving approach Alok Srivastava Highly recommended school. Most lively atmosphere. The warmth in the school makes every child comfortable. Lot of extra efforts taken by the management to introduce practical activities for students to get exposed to real challenges in real life. Hygiene their forte .. Undoubtedly the best school in Thane. Anuja Pradhan The study pattern in rainbow is very well balanced between books & extra activity, I love to here from my 8 yrs son when he explains me everything he learnt this means he is enjoying which was not the case one year back when he was in another school. Great going rainbow teachers keep it up. Chandrasekhar Ella Great school… standard of teaching is of very high level…also give preference to personality development… sports day.. picnic… annual day… every event was owsome… well organised & very nicely presented and executed. Hemalata Nigudkar A school where the teachers care for the students like parents do… the place where every child gets equal opportunity & blossoms into a better version of themselves. Students love to come to school as there is never a dull moment… fun & learning go hand in hand 👍🏻👍🏻 Amrapali Koonapareddy My daughter Aarya goes to this school, it is a great school with amazing infrastructure, safety is the most important thing that they have. Teachers are very supportive. The most thing I like that they have their own organic farm where kids learn the things practically. So far very nice experience. My kid enjoy this schooling. Aarya Rahul Desai I would highly recommend Rainbow International School without hesitation. There are so many options locally that it can be overwhelming to choose but RIS gave my child a stellar foundation plus a nurturing environment that made the school an extension of our family. To watch the excellent teachers at Rainbow International School in action is truly a sight! Dhaval Lodaya Went for inquiry session, wonderful infrastructure, strong security arrangement and lovely people to guide. Surely going ahead for admissions. Would strong recommend Rainbow International School. Ravi Thakur Hello…feeling privileged to share my view on this page. Just a word… Fantastic school. The teachers are Professional, caring and well organized.. infrastructure is outstanding. Children grow intellectually as well as in other co Curricular activities… teachers really care & truly want the best for a child… Surabhi Trivedi Rainbow international School nurtures each child’s natural talents & intelligence to help them achieve their full potential, through Academic Excellence, Outstanding coaching for Sports, Best Infrastructure, Personal Attention and Holistic Development. Nikhil Ghavnalkar The school works on nurturing the kids for all-round development & rather than just focusing on academics. Many events are held throughout the year to encourage students to develop their skills in the relevant domain. The school is affiliated with CBSE & maintain the utmost standard of education. Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane. Aabhay Choudhary Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. My son is happy studying in Rainbow International School. My school is in their Anand Nagar Branch. Netra Patil Chatterjee It’s a great educational establishment to entrust your kids too, with an excellent infrastructure and warm-hearted, friendly and cooperative staff. I will recommend Rainbow International School for you kids. Mark D’Souza

item.title: Pre-Primary Section
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Pre-Primary Section

(Nursery | Jr KG | Sr KG)

The urgency of catching up has increased in a world that is continuously expanding and changing. We introduce our kids into academia in a way that ensures they are constantly one step ahead, learning, growing, and being nurtured without having to worry about the pace.

Their general growth is our sole concern, and thus we incorporate activity/game-based learning into their curriculum from a very young age.
This is included in a curriculum that encourages children to be kids.

Their learning is supported by activities outside and within the four walls of their classroom, extending their horizons as far as possible to make room for growth.

We safeguard them in a conducive yet challenging environment where life-long skills such as creativity, teamwork, and responsibility are cultivated.

Regular participation of parents in their activities is commonplace with us and we believe a steady partnership between us and the former will go a long way in the development of our students

ADMISSIONS ARE OPEN FOR THE ACADEMIC YEAR 24-25

Enquire Now

Curriculum

English

Small letters, 2-3 letters’ words, sentences, Q&A, cursive writing

Math

Comparison, addition, subtraction, time, number names

Hindi

Swar, vyanjan, 2-3 letters’ words

GK

Nature, transport, good manners, living & non-living, day & night, seasons, food, community helpers, my body & home

Curriculum Philosophy

Focused Analysis

Alphabet games, complete sentences, simple math, critical thinking

Conceptual Focus

Visual arts, drama, science, reflection on previous lessons, drawing elaborate figures

Making Connections

Observing the world, making meaning, adequate awareness of surroundings

Exploring Imagination

Use of classroom interaction for framing original stories, inquiry about varied happenings

Kindergarten Methodology

Books

Activity books, E-learning, Flash cards, Memory books

Spaces

Theme Based Classrooms, Picnics and Field Trips

Action

Enactment, Puppet Shows, Muppet Shows, Celebrations

Sound

Audio Visual Aids for Phonics, Rhymes and Stories

Evaluation Strategy

CurriculumTwo Tiers

End term assessments : Before Diwali break & End of the year (March) Monthly assessment to understand ongoing progress

Send Inquiries

Thank You for Contacting Rainbow International School. Kindly fill the inquiry form to enroll your child at Rainbow International School. Once received, Our Admission Counsellor will connect with you shortly, Thank you!

The urgency of catching up has increased in a world that is continuously expanding and changing. We introduce our kids into academia in a way that ensures they are constantly one step ahead, learning, growing, and being nurtured without having to worry about the pace.

Their general growth is our sole concern, and thus we incorporate activity/game-based learning into their curriculum from a very young age.
This is included in a curriculum that encourages children to be kids.

Their learning is supported by activities outside and within the four walls of their classroom, extending their horizons as far as possible to make room for growth.

We safeguard them in a conducive yet challenging environment where life-long skills such as creativity, teamwork, and responsibility are cultivated.

Regular participation of parents in their activities is commonplace with us and we believe a steady partnership between us and the former will go a long way in the development of our students

item.title: Primary section
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Primary Section

(Class-1 to Class-5)

SCHOLASTIC SUBJECTS:

  • English
  • Math
  • Marathi

E.V.S

  • Hindi
  • Computer
  • General Knowledge

CO SCHOLASTIC SUBJECTS:

  • Physical Education
  • Sports (Indoor & Outdoor Games)
  • Value Education
  • Dance & Music
  • Personality Development
  • Art & Craft

TEACHING-LEARNING STRATEGIES:

  • To develop core competencies, a variety of creative and innovative classroom strategies are implemented like pair work, group work, project work and extensive hands-on activities. Digital tools are also used to facilitate learning and creativity.

LANGUAGE DEVELOPMENT:

  • Through Literary Club, students will get a choice to learn a foreign language-French. We encourage verbalizing extensively, enhancing vocabulary, narrating stories, reciting poems, etc

NUMERACY DEVELOPMENT:

  • Mathematic skills play a vital role in the everyday lives of students. They are taught to develop confidence with numbers and measures.

EVALUATION AT THE PRIMARY LEVEL:

  • A system of Continuous Comprehensive Evaluation is followed.
  • Students are graded regularly and evaluation based on the child's participation in various co-curricular activities.
  • Assessment of competencies in languages, Sciences and Mathematics is undertaken regularly.

 

ADMISSIONS ARE OPEN FOR THE ACADEMIC YEAR 24-25

Enquire Now

Curriculum

Language Skills

English, Hindi, Marathi

Math Skills

Computational Skills & Number Problems

Scientific Skills

Scientific Temper for Science & Social Sciences

Creative Skills

Music, Art & Craft Add Joy to Learning

Interpersonal Skills

Clubs & Activities Bring Students Together

Curriculum Philosophy

Communication

Language development with narration, recitation & asking of questions

Awe & Wonder

Exploration of answers through investigation of links with practical experience

Confidence

Development of confidence, self-esteem & self-discipline for Middle School

Psychomotor Skills

Attention to physical fitness and development through yoga, karate & skating

Teaching Methodology

Hands-on Activities

Annual exhibitions for many subjects & always active clubs help students apply what they learn

Tours & Visits

Exciting recreational, educational & cultural excursions get students “think outside the classroom”

Project Work

Individual & group projects get students learn from their families & peers & get better at application

Digital Tools

E-learning amenities make abstract concepts concrete & assist in greater retention of data & processes

Evaluation Strategy

Continuous Comprehensive Evaluation (CCE)

Class participation in class activities, homework, project work, worksheets, individual & group behaviour

Send Inquiries

Thank You for Contacting Rainbow International School. Kindly fill the inquiry form to enroll your child at Rainbow International School. Once received, Our Admission Counsellor will connect with you shortly, Thank you!

item.title: Safety & Security
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Safety & Security

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | Safety & Security |

At Rainbow International School, we believe it’s too narrow-minded of a school to think only about academics.

We take safety and security very seriously. Every child’s physical wellbeing is our responsibility. It’s crucial for their mental wellbeing.

We use our human and technological resources in a variety of ways to ensure that the children are away from any kind of danger.

We also ensure that the children are equipped with the knowledge of how to defend themselves when needed.

We have the best of amenities related to physical and health related safety.

Check Safety Video

Rainbow – Safety & Security

Infirmary, Ambulance & Trained Nurse

CCTV Surveillance & Metal Detectors

CCTV & GPS enabled Transport

100% Female Staff for Preschool

Send Inquiries

Thanks for Visiting Rainbow International School. Kindly fill the inquiry form to enrol your child at Rainbow International School. Once received, Our Admission Counsellor will connect with you shortly, Thank you!

item.title: Awards & Achievements
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Awards & Achievements

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | Awards & Achievements |

15th World Education Summit in Mumbai!

Won awards in the following categories:
1) Innovation in Campus Infrastructure – Rainbow International School
2) Profound Technology usage in Early Childhood Teaching – Rainbow Preschool International

Featured in Knowledge Review Magazine

Yet another Milestone achieved by Rainbow Preschool International. It’s a Proud moment for Rainbow Preschools to get featured in “The 10 Best Preschools in India” in The Knowledge Review Magazine.

100% Result: Rainbow’s First Batch (2018-19)

100% Result: The Times Of India At Rainbow International School, we feel really proud to announce 100% Result of our 10th standard students for the academic year 2018-19. As per The Times Of India, Rainbow International.

Best Preschool & Secondary School in Thane

Rainbow awarded as Best Preschool and Secondary School in Thane
It gives us a great sense of pride that Rainbow Preschools and Rainbow International School have been awarded ‘The Best Preschool and Secondary School in Thane’

Rainbow Wins Award For Excellence

Rainbow Wins Award For Excellence
It gives us immense pleasure to announce that we were awarded “Excellence in Preschool Education” and “Excellence in CBSE Education” in Thane by India Today on Saturday, 7th October 2017.

We are a FIT INDIA School

FIT INDIA Certificate of Recognition
Rainbow International School proud to announce that our declaration has been approved by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and we are a FIT INDIA School!

Swachatam Vidyalay Award

Swachh Survekshan League – 2020
Rainbow Preschools is felicitated by Thane Municipal Corporation for its cleanliness and hygiene on campus.

‘Icon of Thane’ Award

Its indeed a proud moment to share with all of you our Chairperson – Hon. Akila Balbale has been presented with an award by Economic Times for ‘Icon of Thane’, for contributing exemplary education services in Thane city.
A commendable service to our society.

An All Rounder Kid Raghvi Ramanujan

An All Rounder Kid Raghvi Ramanujan Displays Exceptional Talent in Swimming
8-year-old Raghvi Ramanujan is an all rounder. She has also developed a niche interest – swimming! She has just bagged her 101st medal at the Rotary Club Swimming Competition held at Thane.

First Prize in Bharat Vikas Parishad QUIZ COMPETITION

Rainbow International School won the First Prize in Bharat Vikas Parishad QUIZ COMPETITION for the Senior Category at the Branch Level.

48th JUNIOR NATIONAL AQUATIC CHAMPIONSHIP

850 participants from all over India participated in the 48th JUNIOR AQUATIC NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP in Bhubaneswar. Maharashtra was represented by Rainbow International School student RAGHVI RAMANUJAN, who is the only medallist from Thane City with two silver and three bronze medals.

Big win for Rainbow at SGEF 2022!

We are elated to have won the following awards at @scoonewsindia Global Educators Fest 2022:
• Emerging Pre-School Chain of the Year - Editor's Choice: Rainbow Preschool International
• Emerging School of the Year, West India Division: Rainbow International School
Our respected Chairperson, Mrs. Akila Balbale received the awards along with the Director of Academics, Mrs. Vimlesh Sindhu.

Going Plastic Free Drive

Under the "Going Plastic Free Drive," Samarth Bharat Vyaspeeth has set the following goals with the intention of establishing a plastic-free environment. Rainbow International School has since 2019 participated in the "Going Plastic Free Drive"

Awards & Achievements

Rainbow International
[elementor-element k="77c87b55773a2143a1e8545f40860ea0" data=""]

15th World Education Summit in Mumbai!

Won awards in the following categories:
1) Innovation in Campus Infrastructure – Rainbow International School
2) Profound Technology usage in Early Childhood Teaching – Rainbow Preschool International

Featured in Knowledge Review Magazine

Yet another Milestone achieved by Rainbow Preschool International. It’s a Proud moment for Rainbow Preschools to get featured in “The 10 Best Preschools in India” in The Knowledge Review Magazine.

100% Result: Rainbow’s First Batch (2018-19)

100% Result: The Times Of India At Rainbow International School, we feel really proud to announce 100% Result of our 10th standard students for the academic year 2018-19. As per The Times Of India, Rainbow International.

Best Preschool & Secondary School in Thane

Rainbow awarded as Best Preschool and Secondary School in Thane
It gives us a great sense of pride that Rainbow Preschools and Rainbow International School have been awarded ‘The Best Preschool and Secondary School in Thane’

Rainbow Wins Award For Excellence

Rainbow Wins Award For Excellence
It gives us immense pleasure to announce that we were awarded “Excellence in Preschool Education” and “Excellence in CBSE Education” in Thane by India Today on Saturday, 7th October 2017.

We are a FIT INDIA School

FIT INDIA Certificate of Recognition
Rainbow International School proud to announce that our declaration has been approved by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and we are a FIT INDIA School!

Swachatam Vidyalay Award

Swachh Survekshan League – 2020
Rainbow Preschools is felicitated by Thane Municipal Corporation for its cleanliness and hygiene on campus.

‘Icon of Thane’ Award

Its indeed a proud moment to share with all of you our Chairperson – Hon. Akila Balbale has been presented with an award by Economic Times for ‘Icon of Thane’, for contributing exemplary education services in Thane city.
A commendable service to our society.

An All Rounder Kid Raghvi Ramanujan

An All Rounder Kid Raghvi Ramanujan Displays Exceptional Talent in Swimming
8-year-old Raghvi Ramanujan is an all rounder. She has also developed a niche interest – swimming! She has just bagged her 101st medal at the Rotary Club Swimming Competition held at Thane.

First Prize in Bharat Vikas Parishad QUIZ COMPETITION

Rainbow International School won the First Prize in Bharat Vikas Parishad QUIZ COMPETITION for the Senior Category at the Branch Level.

48th JUNIOR NATIONAL AQUATIC CHAMPIONSHIP

850 participants from all over India participated in the 48th JUNIOR AQUATIC NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP in Bhubaneswar. Maharashtra was represented by Rainbow International School student RAGHVI RAMANUJAN, who is the only medallist from Thane City with two silver and three bronze medals.

Big win for Rainbow at SGEF 2022!

We are elated to have won the following awards at @scoonewsindia Global Educators Fest 2022:
• Emerging Pre-School Chain of the Year - Editor's Choice: Rainbow Preschool International
• Emerging School of the Year, West India Division: Rainbow International School
Our respected Chairperson, Mrs. Akila Balbale received the awards along with the Director of Academics, Mrs. Vimlesh Sindhu.

Going Plastic Free Drive

Under the "Going Plastic Free Drive," Samarth Bharat Vyaspeeth has set the following goals with the intention of establishing a plastic-free environment. Rainbow International School has since 2019 participated in the "Going Plastic Free Drive"

Parents Corner

Explore Parent’s Response box down here.

Good school, caring teachers, extremely supportive staff who put in a lot of effort and the experience has been good for us. It’s always a partnership between Institutions and parents to give the best to children and has therefore worked well for us. keep up the good work teachers and thank you. Mohan Ramaswamy I will recommend this school as this school given up so much in terms of values and well organized.. It was first time I sent my daughter for outstation picnic and beyond expectations it was really very well organized and communication between teachers and parents are always welcome… Management and teachers give ears to share parents point of view!! Ruchi Verma We are very Happy with the school… authorities and the management. Teachers are also nice n ensure all the kids get the required attention. Extra curricular activities are also looked after and appreciated. Ratish Pradhan A Progressive School with Very Supportive Management. Teachers & Support staff are very cooperative. Most Importantly, even if there are any issues School always puts forward an issue resolving approach Alok Srivastava Highly recommended school. Most lively atmosphere. The warmth in the school makes every child comfortable. Lot of extra efforts taken by the management to introduce practical activities for students to get exposed to real challenges in real life. Hygiene their forte .. Undoubtedly the best school in Thane. Anuja Pradhan The study pattern in rainbow is very well balanced between books & extra activity, I love to here from my 8 yrs son when he explains me everything he learnt this means he is enjoying which was not the case one year back when he was in another school. Great going rainbow teachers keep it up. Chandrasekhar Ella Great school… standard of teaching is of very high level…also give preference to personality development… sports day.. picnic… annual day… every event was owsome… well organised & very nicely presented and executed. Hemalata Nigudkar A school where the teachers care for the students like parents do… the place where every child gets equal opportunity & blossoms into a better version of themselves. Students love to come to school as there is never a dull moment… fun & learning go hand in hand 👍🏻👍🏻 Amrapali Koonapareddy My daughter Aarya goes to this school, it is a great school with amazing infrastructure, safety is the most important thing that they have. Teachers are very supportive. The most thing I like that they have their own organic farm where kids learn the things practically. So far very nice experience. My kid enjoy this schooling. Aarya Rahul Desai I would highly recommend Rainbow International School without hesitation. There are so many options locally that it can be overwhelming to choose but RIS gave my child a stellar foundation plus a nurturing environment that made the school an extension of our family. To watch the excellent teachers at Rainbow International School in action is truly a sight! Dhaval Lodaya Went for inquiry session, wonderful infrastructure, strong security arrangement and lovely people to guide. Surely going ahead for admissions. Would strong recommend Rainbow International School. Ravi Thakur Hello…feeling privileged to share my view on this page. Just a word… Fantastic school. The teachers are Professional, caring and well organized.. infrastructure is outstanding. Children grow intellectually as well as in other co Curricular activities… teachers really care & truly want the best for a child… Surabhi Trivedi Rainbow international School nurtures each child’s natural talents & intelligence to help them achieve their full potential, through Academic Excellence, Outstanding coaching for Sports, Best Infrastructure, Personal Attention and Holistic Development. Nikhil Ghavnalkar The school works on nurturing the kids for all-round development & rather than just focusing on academics. Many events are held throughout the year to encourage students to develop their skills in the relevant domain. The school is affiliated with CBSE & maintain the utmost standard of education. Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane. Aabhay Choudhary Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. My son is happy studying in Rainbow International School. My school is in their Anand Nagar Branch. Netra Patil Chatterjee It’s a great educational establishment to entrust your kids too, with an excellent infrastructure and warm-hearted, friendly and cooperative staff. I will recommend Rainbow International School for you kids. Mark D’Souza

Good school, caring teachers, extremely supportive staff who put in a lot of effort and the experience has been good for us. It’s always a partnership between Institutions and parents to give the best to children and has therefore worked well for us. keep up the good work teachers and thank you.
Mohan Ramaswamy
I will recommend this school as this school given up so much in terms of values and well organized.. It was first time I sent my daughter for outstation picnic and beyond expectations it was really very well organized and communication between teachers and parents are always welcome… Management and teachers give ears to share parents point of view!!
Ruchi Verma
We are very Happy with the school… authorities and the management. Teachers are also nice n ensure all the kids get the required attention. Extra curricular activities are also looked after and appreciated.
Ratish Pradhan
A Progressive School with Very Supportive Management. Teachers & Support staff are very cooperative. Most Importantly, even if there are any issues School always puts forward an issue resolving approach
Alok Srivastava
Highly recommended school. Most lively atmosphere. The warmth in the school makes every child comfortable. Lot of extra efforts taken by the management to introduce practical activities for students to get exposed to real challenges in real life. Hygiene their forte .. Undoubtedly the best school in Thane.
Anuja Pradhan
The study pattern in rainbow is very well balanced between books & extra activity, I love to here from my 8 yrs son when he explains me everything he learnt this means he is enjoying which was not the case one year back when he was in another school. Great going rainbow teachers keep it up.
Chandrasekhar Ella
Great school… standard of teaching is of very high level…also give preference to personality development… sports day.. picnic… annual day… every event was owsome… well organised & very nicely presented and executed.
Hemalata Nigudkar
A school where the teachers care for the students like parents do… the place where every child gets equal opportunity & blossoms into a better version of themselves. Students love to come to school as there is never a dull moment… fun & learning go hand in hand 👍🏻👍🏻
Amrapali Koonapareddy
My daughter Aarya goes to this school, it is a great school with amazing infrastructure, safety is the most important thing that they have. Teachers are very supportive. The most thing I like that they have their own organic farm where kids learn the things practically. So far very nice experience. My kid enjoy this schooling.
Aarya Rahul Desai
I would highly recommend Rainbow International School without hesitation. There are so many options locally that it can be overwhelming to choose but RIS gave my child a stellar foundation plus a nurturing environment that made the school an extension of our family. To watch the excellent teachers at Rainbow International School in action is truly a sight!
Dhaval Lodaya
Went for inquiry session, wonderful infrastructure, strong security arrangement and lovely people to guide. Surely going ahead for admissions. Would strong recommend Rainbow International School.
Ravi Thakur
Hello…feeling privileged to share my view on this page. Just a word… Fantastic school. The teachers are Professional, caring and well organized.. infrastructure is outstanding. Children grow intellectually as well as in other co Curricular activities… teachers really care & truly want the best for a child…
Surabhi Trivedi
Rainbow international School nurtures each child’s natural talents & intelligence to help them achieve their full potential, through Academic Excellence, Outstanding coaching for Sports, Best Infrastructure, Personal Attention and Holistic Development.
Nikhil Ghavnalkar
The school works on nurturing the kids for all-round development & rather than just focusing on academics. Many events are held throughout the year to encourage students to develop their skills in the relevant domain. The school is affiliated with CBSE & maintain the utmost standard of education. Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane.
Aabhay Choudhary
Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. My son is happy studying in Rainbow International School. My school is in their Anand Nagar Branch.
Netra Patil Chatterjee
It’s a great educational establishment to entrust your kids too, with an excellent infrastructure and warm-hearted, friendly and cooperative staff. I will recommend Rainbow International School for you kids.

item.title: Student Achievements
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Student Achievements

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | Student Achievements |

RESULT OF CLASS X AISSE – MARCH 2019

We are extremely proud of the fact that our first batch of Class X students who appeared for the All India Secondary School Examination in March 2019 brought great laurels to their school by bringing cent percent results.

In all 43 students appeared for the examination. The topper of the school wasMaster Aryan Gulhane with a score of 96.6%, followed by Master Vidhu Agarwal with 96.4% and Miss. Ariba Khan with a score of 96.2%.

Subject Wise Topper

Subject Name of the Student Marks
IT Master Aryan Gulhane 100 / 100
Miss Ketaki Nirbhavane 100 / 100
Miss Ariba Khan 100 / 100
Master SumedhTotade 100 / 100
Social Studies Master Aryan Gulhane 100 / 100
English Miss SakshiHiremath 99 / 100
Hindi Miss Ayushi Trivedi 98 / 100
Mathematics Master Vidhu Agarwal 96 / 100
Science Miss ShriyaGawde 95 / 100

SPORTS ACHIEVEMENTS

Apart from the In house Sports Games Competition and the Annual Sports Day, our students actively participated in different Sports Competitions at the National, State, Zonal and District Level in Swimming Championship, Badminton tournament, Karate Championship, Athletics, Chess, Cycling and Skating. They have won many awards and medals in the above mentioned Championship and Tournaments.

To mention a few: –

Sport / Game Name of the Participant Award
Swimming Championship Miss Raghavi Ramanunjan 300+ medals till date
Badminton Tournament Master Himanshu Desai Gold at National Level (Represented Maharashtra for U- 17)
Cycling U-17 (DSO) Master Atharva Vaidya Gold
South Zone Speed Skating Championship Miss Lakshmi Sahithi Bronze

item.title: Middle section
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Middle Section

(Class-6 to Class-10)

SCHOLASTIC SUBJECTS:

  • English
  • Hindi
  • Maths
  • Science
  • Social Science
  • Marathi French
  • Computer (ICT)

CO SCHOLASTIC SUBJECTS:

  • Sports (Indoor & Outdoor Games)
  • Physical Education
  • Value Education
  • Dance & Music
  • Yoga
  • Personality Development
  • Art & Craft

 

CBSE CURRICULUM:

The curriculum is laid down according to the Secondary School curriculum designed by CBSE.

TEACHING- LEARNING STRATEGIES:

Variety of instructional strategies to assess the strengths, needs and interests of the students are adopted. Technology is extensively used in day-to-day teaching in classrooms.

EVALUATION PATTERN:

  • Two terms with two Summative Assessments One in September and the other in
  • March (Term ISAl+ Term II Sa2).
  • Four Formatives spread over two in each term. [Term I (FAl+ FA2) and Term II
    (Fa3+ Fa4)]

ADMISSIONS ARE OPEN FOR THE ACADEMIC YEAR 24-25

Enquire Now

Curriculum

Language Skills

English, Hindi, Option to Choose Between Marathi/French

Math & Science

Rigorous focus on learning the natural & physical sciences

Social Science

Awareness of our surroundings, our past & our present

Co-scholastic Subjects

Sports, Value Education, Music, Art & Craft, GK

Curriculum Philosophy

Creativity

Development of creative ideas & ways of thinking

Excellence

Multidimensional curriculum to excel in all aspects of school life

Curiosity

Intellectual stimulation for developing talent & maturity of the mind

Personality

Character building through opportunities for leadership

Teaching Methodology

Hands-on Activities

Annual exhibitions for many subjects & always active clubs help students apply what they learn

Tours & Visits

Exciting recreational, educational & cultural excursions get students “think outside the classroom”

Project Work

Individual & group projects get students learn from their families & peers & get better at application

Digital Tools

E-learning amenities make abstract concepts concrete & assist in greater retention of data & processes

Evaluation Strategy
for Middle School

Formal Examination

Summative Assessment Tests: one at the end of each semester
Formative Assessment Tests: two tests per semester to assess on-going learning

Send Inquiries

Thank You for Contacting Rainbow International School. Kindly fill the inquiry form to enroll your child at Rainbow International School. Once received, Our Admission Counsellor will connect with you shortly, Thank you!

item.title: Secondary section
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Secondary Section

(Class-9 and Class-10)

For the final lap of their schooling years, Rainbow ensures, above all, the students are ready to take on the world outside of the school and are prepared for the directions their varied careers would take them on.

Our zestful curriculum is entirely focused on quality learning, one that would shape them for a future not only in India, but globally as well. It is designed to keep them intrigued and engaged, developing them into responsible, confident, and independent thinkers. Keeping in mind the importance of their over-all growth, we ensure their continued involvement in Sports, Arts, and Languages to maintain their physical and mental health in light of their academic commitments.

At Rainbow, our higher graders receive one-on-one career guidance from counselors to ensure they have a medium where they may voice out their concerns, sort through their dilemmas, and navigate through several layers of career options to find one that suits their interests best. Our leadership and teamwork oriented programs hone their own skills and help highlight their own unique qualities.

When our students graduate from here, they do so as academically stellar, responsible, and naturally outstanding young adults, fit to take on the world.

ADMISSIONS ARE OPEN FOR THE ACADEMIC YEAR 24-25

Enquire Now

Curriculum

Language Skills

Two Languages at Secondary Level: English, Hindi

Math & Science

Rigorous focus on learning the natural & physical sciences

Social Science

Awareness of our surroundings, our past & our present

Co-scholastic Subjects

Sports, Value Education, Music, Art & Craft, GK

Curriculum Philosophy

Creativity

Development of creative ideas & ways of thinking

Excellence

Multidimensional curriculum to excel in all aspects of school life

Curiosity

Intellectual stimulation for developing talent & maturity of mind

Personality

Character building through opportunities for leadership

Teaching Methodology

Hands-on Activities

Annual exhibitions for many subjects & always active clubs help students apply what they learn

Tours & Visits

Exciting recreational, educational & cultural excursions get students “think outside the classroom”

Project Work

Individual & group projects get students learn from their families & peers & get better at application

Digital Tools

E-learning amenities make abstract concepts concrete & assist in greater retention of data & processes

Evaluation Strategy

Formal Examination

2 Summative Assessment Tests: one at the end of each semester
4 Formative Assessment Tests: two tests per semester to assess on-going learning

Send Inquiries

Thank You for Contacting Rainbow International School. Kindly fill the inquiry form to enroll your child at Rainbow International School. Once received, Our Admission Counsellor will connect with you shortly, Thank you!

item.title: Senior Secondary section
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Senior Secondary Section

(Class 11 - 12)

SCIENCE

MANDATORY ENGLISH (CORE):

ANY FOUR SUBJECTS MENTION BELOW:

  • Hindi (Core)
  • Mathematics
  • Physics
  • Chemistry
  • Biology
  • Computer Science

 

HUMANITIES

MANDATORY ENGLISH (CORE):

ANY FOUR SUBJECTS MENTION BELOW:

  • Hindi (Core)
  • Psychology
  • Economics
  • History
  • Political Science
  • Computer Science
  • Fine Arts

COMMERCE

MANDATORY ENGLISH (CORE):

ANY FOUR SUBJECTS MENTION BELOW:

  • Hindi (Core)
  • Mathematics
  • Economics
  • Business Studies
  • Accountancy
  • Computer Science

Through a rigorous accreditation process,

RIS has been affiliated to the CBSE Board for Science, Commerce and Humanities Streams.

Details of our affiliation can be found through our affiliation number: 1130661. We offer a slew of subject options for our students to choose from. to ensure their education is customised around what their exact career plans are, and to provide the flexibility to explore alternatives that are rarely offered elsewhere

Curriculum

Commerce

MANDATORY ENGLISH (CORE):
ANY FOUR SUBJECTS MENTION BELOW:

  • Hindi (Core)
  • Mathematics
  • Economics
  • Business Studies
  • Accountancy
  • Computer Science

    • Science

    MANDATORY ENGLISH (CORE):
    ANY FOUR SUBJECTS MENTION BELOW:

  • Hindi (Core)
  • Mathematics
  • Physics
  • Chemistry
  • Biology
  • Computer Science

    • Humanities

    MANDATORY ENGLISH (CORE):
    ANY FOUR SUBJECTS MENTION BELOW:

  • Hindi (Core)
  • Psychology
  • Economics
  • History
  • Political Science
  • Computer Science
  • Fine Arts

    • Curriculum Philosophy

    Creativity

    Development of creative ideas & ways of thinking

    Excellence

    Multidimensional curriculum to excel in all aspects of school life

    Curiosity

    Intellectual stimulation for developing talent & maturity of mind

    Personality

    Character building through opportunities for leadership

    Teaching Methodology

    Experiential Learning Programmes

    Unique International Experiential Learning Certificate Programs, integrated throughout the year-round coursework & offered exclusively to our Grade 11 students.

    Career Counselling

    A Career Guidance Programme, powered by Proventus, an Overseas Education Company and experts in providing ‘customised’ workshops to aspirants, our students stand to receive individual focus and when making that life-altering decision.

    Foreign Language Classes

    Adding to a plethora of skill-developing options in store for our students, our Foreign Language Skill Development Programme is designed to present one of the most relevant languages of the current era, that is, French.

    Summer Internship Programme

    In addition to our eclectic arrangement of workshops, lectures from industry experts and the academia carefully structured by our experienced mentors, our students have internship opportunities to look out for during their Senior Secondary years

    Evaluation Strategy

    Formal Examination

    2 Summative Assessment Tests: one at the end of each semester
    4 Formative Assessment Tests: two tests per semester to assess on-going learning

    Send Inquiries

    Thank You for Contacting Rainbow International School. Kindly fill the inquiry form to enroll your child at Rainbow International School. Once received, Our Admission Counsellor will connect with you shortly, Thank you!

item.content:encoded:
Rainbow School Admission

Rainbow International School | Rainbow School Admission | Rainbow International

You are One Step Further towards providing your child with the best education.

Technology, its gadgets, and the internet have indisputably revolutionized the world, and it is time we introduced our young learners to its many advantages.

Our latest venture is Virtual Learning, where our students will experience a full-course education with the aid of Apps such as ‘Google Classroom’, presentations by teachers, and live lessons. Their coursework, assessments, and projects will be available online, with the access right at their fingertips. Our students can now tap into their coursework even when away from school, and at any time of the day.

The growth in digital technology over the years has opened doors for education to be taught and experienced differently as well. On our Virtual Learning Platform, this digital tool will be used to spice things up by making learning an exciting adventure that adds an incalculable value to their overall education.

Explore Parent’s Response box down here.

Good school, caring teachers, extremely supportive staff who put in a lot of effort and the experience has been good for us. It’s always a partnership between Institutions and parents to give the best to children and has therefore worked well for us. keep up the good work teachers and thank you. Mohan Ramaswamy I will recommend this school as this school given up so much in terms of values and well organized.. It was first time I sent my daughter for outstation picnic and beyond expectations it was really very well organized and communication between teachers and parents are always welcome… Management and teachers give ears to share parents point of view!! Ruchi Verma We are very Happy with the school… authorities and the management. Teachers are also nice n ensure all the kids get the required attention. Extra curricular activities are also looked after and appreciated. Ratish Pradhan A Progressive School with Very Supportive Management. Teachers & Support staff are very cooperative. Most Importantly, even if there are any issues School always puts forward an issue resolving approach Alok Srivastava Highly recommended school. Most lively atmosphere. The warmth in the school makes every child comfortable. Lot of extra efforts taken by the management to introduce practical activities for students to get exposed to real challenges in real life. Hygiene their forte .. Undoubtedly the best school in Thane. Anuja Pradhan The study pattern in rainbow is very well balanced between books & extra activity, I love to here from my 8 yrs son when he explains me everything he learnt this means he is enjoying which was not the case one year back when he was in another school. Great going rainbow teachers keep it up. Chandrasekhar Ella Great school… standard of teaching is of very high level…also give preference to personality development… sports day.. picnic… annual day… every event was owsome… well organised & very nicely presented and executed. Hemalata Nigudkar A school where the teachers care for the students like parents do… the place where every child gets equal opportunity & blossoms into a better version of themselves. Students love to come to school as there is never a dull moment… fun & learning go hand in hand 👍🏻👍🏻 Amrapali Koonapareddy My daughter Aarya goes to this school, it is a great school with amazing infrastructure, safety is the most important thing that they have. Teachers are very supportive. The most thing I like that they have their own organic farm where kids learn the things practically. So far very nice experience. My kid enjoy this schooling. Aarya Rahul Desai I would highly recommend Rainbow International School without hesitation. There are so many options locally that it can be overwhelming to choose but RIS gave my child a stellar foundation plus a nurturing environment that made the school an extension of our family. To watch the excellent teachers at Rainbow International School in action is truly a sight! Dhaval Lodaya Went for inquiry session, wonderful infrastructure, strong security arrangement and lovely people to guide. Surely going ahead for admissions. Would strong recommend Rainbow International School. Ravi Thakur Hello…feeling privileged to share my view on this page. Just a word… Fantastic school. The teachers are Professional, caring and well organized.. infrastructure is outstanding. Children grow intellectually as well as in other co Curricular activities… teachers really care & truly want the best for a child… Surabhi Trivedi Rainbow international School nurtures each child’s natural talents & intelligence to help them achieve their full potential, through Academic Excellence, Outstanding coaching for Sports, Best Infrastructure, Personal Attention and Holistic Development. Nikhil Ghavnalkar The school works on nurturing the kids for all-round development & rather than just focusing on academics. Many events are held throughout the year to encourage students to develop their skills in the relevant domain. The school is affiliated with CBSE & maintain the utmost standard of education. Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane. Aabhay Choudhary Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. My son is happy studying in Rainbow International School. My school is in their Anand Nagar Branch. Netra Patil Chatterjee It’s a great educational establishment to entrust your kids too, with an excellent infrastructure and warm-hearted, friendly and cooperative staff. I will recommend Rainbow International School for you kids. Mark D’Souza

item.title: Extracurriculars
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Extracurriculars

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | Extracurriculars |

We are a FIT INDIA School

Our declaration has been approved by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and we are a FIT INDIA School! View Certificate

Sports to Add Action

Clubs to Provide Intellectual Stimulation

Teaching Methodology

Exhibitions

Annual Exhibitions for Science, Maths, Social Science, EVS & Language

Tours & Visits

Exciting Recreational, Educational & Cultural Excursions

Special Assembly

Celebration of Fun & Educational U.N. days, Motivational Speeches & Meaningful Activities

Cultural Activities

Annual Day, Sports Day, Indian Festivals & School Events

Important SMC Decisions

The Important SMC decisions taken by the SMC were as follows:
1. To apply for upgradation to CBSE.
2. To gain approval for shift system from CBSE.
3. Give approval for appointment of teaching staff as per requirement.

Field of Environment Education

The school’s environment education programme aims to sensitize the students to the environment through hands on year long thought provoking activities. The vision of the School Management is to convert RIS into a Green School in the coming years.

The first step taken in this direction has been to conduct an audit of the existing Bio diversity and to further enhance it by developing an academic garden based on syllabus, vegetable and medicinal patch along with composting. The other audits to be taken in, future will be waste management, water and air quality.
Butterfly garden has been developed on a plot of 500sq.ft, wherein different host plant and nectar producing plants have been nurtured to atleastbutterflies. As of now many species of butterflies can be spotted. The students are exposed to the lifecycle of a butterfly in reality.
Tree Plantation Drive was organized on Children’s Day to sensitize the young minds on the importance of nurturing trees.
Swatch Bharat Abhiyan was conducted to instill in the minds the importance of keeping their surroundings clean for a healthy body and mind.

INNOVATIONS

Inclusive teaching practice for Mathematics. On World Smile Day a very innovative method of teaching the concepts of area was adopted by the Maths teachers of Std VI &VII. The students were asked to measure their own smiles. Along with Maths the students were encouraged to understand the value of a smile as a stress buster.
Experiential teaching practice in EVS: The students were taken to the Butterfly Garden created in their own school premises to impart the knowledged of the life of a butterfly.
To dissiminate mitigation measures that can be taken by the community at large students of Class IX and X are made to create innovative table top calendars on the topics related to several natural and man-made calamities.
To promote waste management programme that is initiated by the citizens of Thane , the school has joined the Plastic Revitalization Program. This has helped to instill the importance of waste management at source amongst the students and their families.
Assembly programmes , workshops for parents and training session for teachers are designed and conducted on innovative topics like regard for senior citizens , fitness programme etc.

PTA Activities

Members of the PTA actively involved themselves in the following activities:

A member arranged a talk for the students by the Ex Chairman of ISRO Shri A. S Kiran Kumar.
Help in resolving staff and parent related issues.
Involve themselves in the co-ordination and success of school programs like the School exhibition “IMPULSE” , Annual Day Programme and all the other cultural programmes.

The vision of the School Management is to convert RIS into a Green School in the coming years.<\/p><p>The first step taken in this direction has been to conduct an audit of the existing Bio diversity and to further enhance it by developing an academic garden based on syllabus, vegetable and medicinal patch along with composting. The other audits to be taken in, future will be waste management, water and air quality.<br \/>Butterfly garden has been developed on a plot of 500sq.ft, wherein different host plant and nectar producing plants have been nurtured to atleastbutterflies. The students are exposed to the lifecycle of a butterfly in reality.<br \/>Tree Plantation Drive was organized on Children\u2019s Day to sensitize the young minds on the importance of nurturing trees.<br \/>Swatch Bharat Abhiyan was conducted to instill in the minds the importance of keeping their surroundings clean for a healthy body and mind.<\/p><p><strong>INNOVATIONS<\/strong><\/p><p>Inclusive teaching practice for Mathematics. On World Smile Day a very innovative method of teaching the concepts of area was adopted by the Maths teachers of Std VI &VII. The students were asked to measure their own smiles. Along with Maths the students were encouraged to understand the value of a smile as a stress buster.<br \/>Experiential teaching practice in EVS: The students were taken to the Butterfly Garden created in their own school premises to impart the knowledged of the life of a butterfly.<br \/>To dissiminate mitigation measures that can be taken by the community at large students of Class IX and X are made to create innovative table top calendars on the topics related to several natural and man-made calamities.<br \/>To promote waste management programme that is initiated by the citizens of Thane , the school has joined the Plastic Revitalization Program. Good school, caring teachers, extremely supportive staff who put in a lot of effort and the experience has been good for us. It’s always a partnership between Institutions and parents to give the best to children and has therefore worked well for us. keep up the good work teachers and thank you.
Mohan Ramaswamy
I will recommend this school as this school given up so much in terms of values and well organized.. It was first time I sent my daughter for outstation picnic and beyond expectations it was really very well organized and communication between teachers and parents are always welcome… Management and teachers give ears to share parents point of view!!
Ruchi Verma
We are very Happy with the school… authorities and the management. Teachers are also nice n ensure all the kids get the required attention. Extra curricular activities are also looked after and appreciated.
Ratish Pradhan
A Progressive School with Very Supportive Management. Teachers & Support staff are very cooperative. Most Importantly, even if there are any issues School always puts forward an issue resolving approach
Alok Srivastava
Highly recommended school. Most lively atmosphere. The warmth in the school makes every child comfortable. Lot of extra efforts taken by the management to introduce practical activities for students to get exposed to real challenges in real life. Hygiene their forte .. Undoubtedly the best school in Thane.
Anuja Pradhan
The study pattern in rainbow is very well balanced between books & extra activity, I love to here from my 8 yrs son when he explains me everything he learnt this means he is enjoying which was not the case one year back when he was in another school. Great going rainbow teachers keep it up.
Chandrasekhar Ella
Great school… standard of teaching is of very high level…also give preference to personality development… sports day.. picnic… annual day… every event was owsome… well organised & very nicely presented and executed.
Hemalata Nigudkar
A school where the teachers care for the students like parents do… the place where every child gets equal opportunity & blossoms into a better version of themselves. Students love to come to school as there is never a dull moment… fun & learning go hand in hand 👍🏻👍🏻
Amrapali Koonapareddy
My daughter Aarya goes to this school, it is a great school with amazing infrastructure, safety is the most important thing that they have. Teachers are very supportive. The most thing I like that they have their own organic farm where kids learn the things practically. So far very nice experience. My kid enjoy this schooling.
Aarya Rahul Desai
I would highly recommend Rainbow International School without hesitation. There are so many options locally that it can be overwhelming to choose but RIS gave my child a stellar foundation plus a nurturing environment that made the school an extension of our family. To watch the excellent teachers at Rainbow International School in action is truly a sight!
Dhaval Lodaya
Went for inquiry session, wonderful infrastructure, strong security arrangement and lovely people to guide. Surely going ahead for admissions. Would strong recommend Rainbow International School.
Ravi Thakur
Hello…feeling privileged to share my view on this page. Just a word… Fantastic school. The teachers are Professional, caring and well organized.. infrastructure is outstanding. Children grow intellectually as well as in other co Curricular activities… teachers really care & truly want the best for a child…
Surabhi Trivedi
Rainbow international School nurtures each child’s natural talents & intelligence to help them achieve their full potential, through Academic Excellence, Outstanding coaching for Sports, Best Infrastructure, Personal Attention and Holistic Development.
Nikhil Ghavnalkar
The school works on nurturing the kids for all-round development & rather than just focusing on academics. Many events are held throughout the year to encourage students to develop their skills in the relevant domain. The school is affiliated with CBSE & maintain the utmost standard of education. Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane.
Aabhay Choudhary
Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. My son is happy studying in Rainbow International School. My school is in their Anand Nagar Branch.
Netra Patil Chatterjee
It’s a great educational establishment to entrust your kids too, with an excellent infrastructure and warm-hearted, friendly and cooperative staff. I will recommend Rainbow International School for you kids.
Mark D’Souza

item.title: Rainbow Preschool International
item.dc:creator: infivisionmedia
item.content:encoded:
Rainbow Preschool International

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | Rainbow Preschool International |

A Chain of 6 Schools Across Maharashtra

While Rainbow International School was established in 2009, Rainbow Preschools were set up in 2007 and have been going strong ever since.

Our preschoolers learn to push the boundaries of their imagination and think outside the box. We instill life skills in them such as honesty, confidence, independence, and showing kindness to others through our curriculum, unique storytelling techniques, and mini excursions to everyday locations such as the bank, post office, supermarket etc.

Our branches have a warm vibrant vibe, making the environment conducive for our students. We find that they are more proactive, communicative, and cheerful surrounded by such exuberance. The activities we engage them in complement nicely with the mood set by the architecture.

Our preschool branches have an all-women staff which includes teachers, housekeepers, and security.

Our Programmes

Our Programmes

Playful Learning for Stronger Foundation

Playgroup

Ideal for 1.5-2.5 years old children – learning introduced with fun activities like puppet shows, play, & colours

Know More

Nursery

Curriculum in sync with the children’s mental & physical development – group reading, writing, muppet shows, dancing, yoga and more

Know More

Kindergarten

Exciting experience learning sophisticated skills in different subjects: English, Math, EVS, GK, Art & Craft

Know More

Happy Times

Homely care for children aged 2 to 10 years – offering playful companionship for those whose parents are away at work.

Know More

Kids Activity Club

Ideal for developing talents of children aged 2-10 years with 20+ activities like brain gym, aerobics & drama

Know More

Summer Camp

Special programmes for perfect holiday planning – nurturing creativity and spending fun time with friends & hobbies

Know More

Parents Corner

Explore Parent’s Response box down here.

Our branches have a warm vibrant vibe, making the environment conducive for our students. We find that they are more proactive, communicative, and cheerful surrounded by such exuberance. The activities we engage them in complement nicely with the mood set by the architecture.<\/p>
