Anuja Pradhan
The study pattern in rainbow is very well balanced between books & extra activity, I love to here from my 8 yrs son when he explains me everything he learnt this means he is enjoying which was not the case one year back when he was in another school. Great going rainbow teachers keep it up.
Chandrasekhar Ella
Great school… standard of teaching is of very high level…also give preference to personality development… sports day.. picnic… annual day… every event was owsome… well organised & very nicely presented and executed.
Hemalata Nigudkar
A school where the teachers care for the students like parents do… the place where every child gets equal opportunity & blossoms into a better version of themselves. Students love to come to school as there is never a dull moment… fun & learning go hand in hand 👍🏻👍🏻
Amrapali Koonapareddy
My daughter Aarya goes to this school, it is a great school with amazing infrastructure, safety is the most important thing that they have. Teachers are very supportive. The most thing I like that they have their own organic farm where kids learn the things practically. So far very nice experience. My kid enjoy this schooling.
Aarya Rahul Desai
I would highly recommend Rainbow International School without hesitation. There are so many options locally that it can be overwhelming to choose but RIS gave my child a stellar foundation plus a nurturing environment that made the school an extension of our family. To watch the excellent teachers at Rainbow International School in action is truly a sight!
Dhaval Lodaya
Went for inquiry session, wonderful infrastructure, strong security arrangement and lovely people to guide. Surely going ahead for admissions. Would strong recommend Rainbow International School.
Ravi Thakur
Hello…feeling privileged to share my view on this page. Just a word… Fantastic school. The teachers are Professional, caring and well organized.. infrastructure is outstanding. Children grow intellectually as well as in other co Curricular activities… teachers really care & truly want the best for a child…
Surabhi Trivedi
Rainbow international School nurtures each child’s natural talents & intelligence to help them achieve their full potential, through Academic Excellence, Outstanding coaching for Sports, Best Infrastructure, Personal Attention and Holistic Development.
Nikhil Ghavnalkar
The school works on nurturing the kids for all-round development & rather than just focusing on academics. Many events are held throughout the year to encourage students to develop their skills in the relevant domain. The school is affiliated with CBSE & maintain the utmost standard of education. Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane.
Aabhay Choudhary
Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. My son is happy studying in Rainbow International School. My school is in their Anand Nagar Branch.
Netra Patil Chatterjee
It’s a great educational establishment to entrust your kids too, with an excellent infrastructure and warm-hearted, friendly and cooperative staff. I will recommend Rainbow International School for you kids.
Mark D’Souza
","scripts":[],"styles":[]}}

Rainbow International SchoolNURSERY TO CLASS 12thCBSE AFFILIATED Know More WORLD-CLASS EDUCATION, INDIAN VALUES:
Rainbow International School NURSERY TO CLASS 12th CBSE AFFILIATED Know More

Welcome to
Rainbow International School

Educating Students for Success in an Evolving World Technology in Classrooms E-learning resources for better learning & memory Extracurricular Activities Annual events, clubs, exhibitions, music, art & organic farming Personality Development Attention to etiquette, team work & self-confidence Philosophy of Sensitivity Incorporating social & environmental consciousness

Why Rainbow ?

 Rainbow International School is a trailblazer in the arena of education with a passion for excellence. We are considered as one of the top CBSE schools in Thane west because we emphasize that the child enjoys his learning, dares to dream, and becomes a lifelong learner.

Our expert educators provide a conducive environment with their multicultural perspectives. Social ethics like empathy, compassion, and respect for others is inculcated in the pedagogy. We provide state-of-the-art facilities, technologies, and infrastructure to optimize teaching and learning outcomes.

Our educational programs support child's academic, moral, social, and physical development. Our curriculum reflects global, rural, and urban dimensions, thereby preparing our students to face all future challenges. At the preschool level, we follow the theory of Multiple Intelligence, for holistic development.

At Rainbow, students are encouraged to build a positive self-image and evolve into well-disciplined, resourceful, and accountable human beings. Emotional Intelligence is nurtured through well-designed activities and programs to overcome discrimination, prejudice, and bullying.

We are proud to consistently deliver world-class education and remain the best international school in Thane west.

Amenities & Facilities

We offer globally recognized educational resources and state-of-the-art facilities that make Rainbow International School the best international school in Thane.

Student Achievements

At Rainbow, Student Accomplishments are acknowledged and honored. Here you can view the list of our Best Achievers.

Safety &
Security

Student safety & well-being is our top-most priority and we ensure it is safeguarded through the stringent security measures of modern times.

Beyond The Classroom

The real aim of education is not only knowledge but also ACTION.

We provide rigorous, comprehensive & Cohesive learning. PROGRAMME that is designed to meet the Social Physical & Cultural needs of an International student body as well

Know more

Parents Corner

Explore Parent’s Response box down here.

Good school, caring teachers, extremely supportive staff who put in a lot of effort and the experience has been good for us. It’s always a partnership between Institutions and parents to give the best to children and has therefore worked well for us. keep up the good work teachers and thank you. Mohan Ramaswamy I will recommend this school as this school given up so much in terms of values and well organized.. It was first time I sent my daughter for outstation picnic and beyond expectations it was really very well organized and communication between teachers and parents are always welcome… Management and teachers give ears to share parents point of view!! Ruchi Verma We are very Happy with the school… authorities and the management. Teachers are also nice n ensure all the kids get the required attention. Extra curricular activities are also looked after and appreciated. Ratish Pradhan A Progressive School with Very Supportive Management. Teachers & Support staff are very cooperative. Most Importantly, even if there are any issues School always puts forward an issue resolving approach Alok Srivastava Highly recommended school. Most lively atmosphere. The warmth in the school makes every child comfortable. Lot of extra efforts taken by the management to introduce practical activities for students to get exposed to real challenges in real life. Hygiene their forte .. Undoubtedly the best school in Thane. Anuja Pradhan The study pattern in rainbow is very well balanced between books & extra activity, I love to here from my 8 yrs son when he explains me everything he learnt this means he is enjoying which was not the case one year back when he was in another school. Great going rainbow teachers keep it up. Chandrasekhar Ella Great school… standard of teaching is of very high level…also give preference to personality development… sports day.. picnic… annual day… every event was owsome… well organised & very nicely presented and executed. Hemalata Nigudkar A school where the teachers care for the students like parents do… the place where every child gets equal opportunity & blossoms into a better version of themselves. Students love to come to school as there is never a dull moment… fun & learning go hand in hand 👍🏻👍🏻 Amrapali Koonapareddy My daughter Aarya goes to this school, it is a great school with amazing infrastructure, safety is the most important thing that they have. Teachers are very supportive. The most thing I like that they have their own organic farm where kids learn the things practically. So far very nice experience. My kid enjoy this schooling. Aarya Rahul Desai I would highly recommend Rainbow International School without hesitation. There are so many options locally that it can be overwhelming to choose but RIS gave my child a stellar foundation plus a nurturing environment that made the school an extension of our family. To watch the excellent teachers at Rainbow International School in action is truly a sight! Dhaval Lodaya Went for inquiry session, wonderful infrastructure, strong security arrangement and lovely people to guide. Surely going ahead for admissions. Would strong recommend Rainbow International School. Ravi Thakur Hello…feeling privileged to share my view on this page. Just a word… Fantastic school. The teachers are Professional, caring and well organized.. infrastructure is outstanding. Children grow intellectually as well as in other co Curricular activities… teachers really care & truly want the best for a child… Surabhi Trivedi Rainbow international School nurtures each child’s natural talents & intelligence to help them achieve their full potential, through Academic Excellence, Outstanding coaching for Sports, Best Infrastructure, Personal Attention and Holistic Development. Nikhil Ghavnalkar The school works on nurturing the kids for all-round development & rather than just focusing on academics. Many events are held throughout the year to encourage students to develop their skills in the relevant domain. The school is affiliated with CBSE & maintain the utmost standard of education. Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane. Aabhay Choudhary Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. My son is happy studying in Rainbow International School. My school is in their Anand Nagar Branch. Netra Patil Chatterjee It’s a great educational establishment to entrust your kids too, with an excellent infrastructure and warm-hearted, friendly and cooperative staff. I will recommend Rainbow International School for you kids. Mark D’Souza

Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy |

Rainbow International School (“We” or “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting it through our compliance with this policy.

This policy describes the types of information we may collect from you or that you may provide when you visit the website located at www.rainbowinternationalschool.in and our other websites, including our websites located at other top-level domains or resolving to or linking to or from www.rainbowinternationalschool.in (our “Websites”) and our practices for collecting, using, maintaining, protecting and disclosing that information.

We have designed our Websites with parents and children in mind. We appreciate and respect our visitors’ concerns for their safety when personal information is shared with us. We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that is submitted to us. While we take reasonable measures to safeguard the confidential information that you provide, Rainbow International School has no liability for the disclosure of any information that is obtained due to transmission errors or for the disclosure of any information obtained by any unauthorized acts by third parties.

This policy applies to information we collect:

On our Websites; or
In e-mail, text and other electronic messages between you and our Websites.
It does not apply to information collected by:

us offline or through any other means, including on any other website operated by us or any third party (including our affiliates and subsidiaries); or
any third party (including our affiliates and subsidiaries).
Please read this policy carefully to understand our policies and practices regarding your information and how we will treat it. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, you may choose not to use our Websites. By accessing or using our Websites, you agree and consent to this privacy policy. This policy may change from time to time (see the section below entitled Changes to our Privacy and Cookie Policy). Any changes or updates to the privacy policy are effective immediately upon posting to the Websites and your continued use of the Websites after we make changes is deemed to be acceptance of those changes, so please check the policy periodically for updates.

If you wish to browse the Websites, you may generally do so anonymously. There is no need to provide any personal information while browsing our Websites. If you choose to contact us requesting assistance with products and/or services, product and/or service information or general questions, we ask for your personal information on our forms, including but not limited to our Contact Us/Request Information, Service Request and E-newsletter Sign Up forms and other inquiry forms. This information helps us process your inquiry and provide the best service possible.

Children Under the Age of 13

A child’s privacy is important to us. No one under age 13 may provide any personal information to or on our Websites. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are under 13, do not use or provide any information on the Websites or on or through any of the features on the Websites or provide any information about yourself to us, including your name, address, telephone number, e-mail address or any screen name or user name you may use. If we learn we have collected or received personal information from a child under 13 without verification of parental consent, we will delete that information. Providing any personal information regarding a child, including the child’s name and age is strictly at the parent’s discretion. At any time a parent can request to review their personal information and their child’s personal information that they have submitted to us. A parent may also ask to have it deleted by sending a request to admin@rainbowinternationalschool.in

If a visitor to the Websites is under the age of 18, they should read the privacy policy with their parents for guidance.

ARTICLE I

Information We Collect About You and How We Collect It

We collect several types of information from and about users of our Websites, including information:

by which you may be personally identified, such as name, postal address, e-mail address, telephone number, or any other information the Websites collect that is defined as personal or personally identifiable information under an applicable law (“personal information”); and or
about your internet connection, the equipment you use to access our Websites and usage details.
We collect this information:

Directly from you when you provide it to us; and/or
Automatically as you navigate through the site. Information collected automatically may include usage details, IP addresses and information
Information You Provide to Us.

The information we collect on or through our Websites may include:

Information that you provide by filling in forms on our Websites, which includes, but is not limited to, information (e.g., First Name, Last Name, Address, Phone Number) provided at the time of subscribing to our newsletter, or requesting services by filling in our Contact Us/Request Information, E-Newsletter Sign-Up, Technical Phone Support Request or Customer Service Request forms or by some other mechanism;
Information collected when you report a problem with our Websites;
Records and copies of your correspondence (including e-mail addresses), if you contact us; and/or
Information We Collect Through Automatic Data Collection Technologies.

As you navigate through and interact with our Websites, we (or a third party designated by us) may use automatic data collection technologies to collect certain information about your equipment, browsing actions and patterns, including:

Details of your visits to our Websites, including traffic data, location data, logs and other communication data and the resources that you access and use on the Websites.
Information about your computer and internet connection, including your IP address, the page(s) you request, the domain name of the website from which you may link to the Websites, your computer operating system and browser type.
The information we (or a third party designated by us) collect automatically is statistical data and does not include personal information. It is stored and used for aggregate research, promotional purposes and for future site development to better understand your needs and improve our products and services, to improve our Websites and to deliver better and more personalized service, including by enabling us to:

Estimate our audience size and usage patterns and analyze certain trends and statistics related to user sessions;
Store information about your preferences, allowing us to customize our Websites according to your individual interests;
Speed up your searches;
Recognize you when you return to our Websites.
The technologies we (or a third party designated by us) use for this automatic data collection may include:

Cookies (or browser cookies). A cookie is a small file placed on the hard drive of your computer. Generally, we use cookies to remind us of who you are, tailor our products and services to suit your personal interests, estimate our audience size, and/or analyze your visiting patterns you may refuse to accept browser cookies by activating the appropriate setting on your browser. However, if you select this setting you may be unable to access certain parts of our Websites. Unless you have adjusted your browser setting so that it will refuse cookies, our system will issue cookies when you direct your browser to our Websites.
Web Beacons. Pages of our Websites and our e-mails may contain small electronic files known as web beacons (also referred to as clear gifs, pixel tags and single-pixel gifs) that permit RAINBOW INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL, for example, to count users who have visited those pages or opened an e-mail and for other related website statistics (for example, recording the popularity of certain website content and verifying system and server integrity).
How We Use Your Information:

We process personal information for certain legitimate business purposes and we may use information that we collect about you or that you provide to us, including any personal information:

When you submit your personal information to us unless you specify otherwise, you are entered into our consumer database. You may then be added to our list to receive e-mails regarding our special promotional offers and new product and/or service introductions periodically. We will not send you junk mailings or mail that contains pop ups, only information about our products and specials that are being offered;
To present our Websites and their contents to you;
To provide you with information that you request from us;
To fulfill orders for services that you may place through the Websites or for any other purpose for which you provide it;
To notify you about changes to our Websites or any products or services we offer or provide through it;
So that we can perform the contract and/or agreement we are about to or have entered into with you;
Where it is necessary for our legitimate interests (or those of a third party) and your interests and fundamental rights do not override those interests;
Where we need to comply with a legal or regulatory obligation;
For vital interest;
In any other way we may describe when you provide the information; or
For any other purpose with your consent.
When you submit your personal information to us, unless you specify otherwise, you are entered into our consumer database. You may then be added to our list to receive communiques regarding promotional offers, new product and/or service introductions, industry updates and other news and events you may find interesting. We will not send you junk mailings or any communication unrelated to our business.

We make sure to consider and balance any potential impact on you and your rights before we process your personal data for our legitimate interests and do not use your personal data for activities where our interests are overridden by the impact on you (unless we have your consent or are otherwise required or permitted to do so by law). Note that we may process your personal information for more than one lawful ground depending upon the specific purpose for which we are using the data. We will retain your personal data for only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes we collected it for.

For more information, see the section titled Choices About How We Use and Disclose Your Information below.

Disclosure of Your Information.

We may disclose aggregated, non-personal information about our users without restriction.

We may disclose personal information that we collect or you provide as described in this privacy policy:

To our subsidiaries and affiliates;
To contractors, service providers and other third parties we use to support our business and who are bound by contractual obligations to keep personal information confidential and use it only for the purposes for which we disclose it to them;
To a buyer or other successor in the event of a merger, divestiture, restructuring, reorganization, dissolution or other sale or transfer of some or all of Rainbow International School’s assets, whether as a going concern or as part of bankruptcy, liquidation or similar proceeding, in which personal information held by Rainbow International School about our Websites users is among the assets transferred;
To fulfill the purpose for which you provide it;
For any other purpose disclosed by us when you provide the information; or
With your consent.
We may also disclose your personal information:

To comply with any court order, law or legal process, including to respond to any government or regulatory request;
To enforce or apply our Terms of Use (located at [TERMS OF USE LINK]) and other agreements, including for billing and collection purposes; or
If we believe disclosure is necessary or appropriate to protect the rights, property, or safety of Rainbow International School, our customers or others.
Choices About How We Use and Disclose Your Information.

We strive to provide you with choices regarding the personal information you provide to us. We have created mechanisms to provide you with the following control over your information:

Tracking Technologies and Advertising. You can set your browser to refuse all or some browser cookies, or to alert you when cookies are being sent. If you disable or refuse cookies, please note that some parts of this site may then be inaccessible or not function properly.
Communications from Rainbow International School. If you wish to opt-out of receiving any future communication from us, including e-mail, post/mail, SMS/text or phone call; and would like to be removed from our database, please send your request to [WEBSITE CONTACT MAIL]. Please include your full contact information including name, company name, complete address, phone number and email. You may also unsubscribe from marketing email by clicking the link at the bottom of the email at any time. This opt out does not apply to information provided to Rainbow International School as a result of a product and/or service experience or other transactions.
Data Security.

Rainbow International School must collect certain information in order to operate the Websites and to fulfill your requests or enable participation in certain online activities. We have implemented reasonable security measure designed to secure the personal information under our control from accidental loss and from unauthorized access, use, alteration and disclosure. We use industry-standard practices, such as encrypted storage and password protection systems, to safeguard the confidentiality of information.

Unfortunately, the transmission of information via the internet is not completely secure. Although we do our best to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee the security of your personal information transmitted to our Websites. Any transmission of personal information is at your own risk. We are not responsible for circumvention of any privacy settings or security measures contained on the Websites.

Changes to Our Privacy and Cookie Policy.

This policy may change from time to time. It is our practice to post any changes we make to our privacy policy on this page. Any changes or updates to the privacy policy are effective immediately upon posting to the Websites and your continued use of the Websites after we make changes is deemed to be acceptance of those changes, so please check the policy periodically for updates. The date the privacy policy was last revised is identified at the bottom of this page. You are responsible for periodically visiting our Websites and this privacy policy to check for any changes.

Contact Information.
To ask questions or comment about this privacy policy and our privacy practices, contact us at: admin@rainbowinternationalschool.in.

Last modified: 09/08/2019

Estimate our audience size and usage patterns and analyze certain trends and statistics related to user sessions;
Store information about your preferences, allowing us to customize our Websites according to your individual interests;
Speed up your searches;
Recognize you when you return to our Websites.
The technologies we (or a third party designated by us) use for this automatic data collection may include:<\/p>

Cookies (or browser cookies). A cookie is a small file placed on the hard drive of your computer. Generally, we use cookies to remind us of who you are, tailor our products and services to suit your personal interests, estimate our audience size, and\/or analyze your visiting patterns you may refuse to accept browser cookies by activating the appropriate setting on your browser. However, if you select this setting you may be unable to access certain parts of our Websites. Unless you have adjusted your browser setting so that it will refuse cookies, our system will issue cookies when you direct your browser to our Websites.
Web Beacons. Pages of our Websites and our e-mails may contain small electronic files known as web beacons (also referred to as clear gifs, pixel tags and single-pixel gifs) that permit RAINBOW INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL, for example, to count users who have visited those pages or opened an e-mail and for other related website statistics (for example, recording the popularity of certain website content and verifying system and server integrity).
How We Use Your Information:<\/p>

We process personal information for certain legitimate business purposes and we may use information that we collect about you or that you provide to us, including any personal information:<\/p>

When you submit your personal information to us unless you specify otherwise, you are entered into our consumer database. You may then be added to our list to receive e-mails regarding our special promotional offers and new product and\/or service introductions periodically. We will not send you junk mailings or mail that contains pop ups, only information about our products and specials that are being offered;
To present our Websites and their contents to you;
To provide you with information that you request from us;
To fulfill orders for services that you may place through the Websites or for any other purpose for which you provide it;
To notify you about changes to our Websites or any products or services we offer or provide through it;
So that we can perform the contract and\/or agreement we are about to or have entered into with you;
Where it is necessary for our legitimate interests (or those of a third party) and your interests and fundamental rights do not override those interests;
Where we need to comply with a legal or regulatory obligation;
For vital interest;
In any other way we may describe when you provide the information; or
For any other purpose with your consent.
When you submit your personal information to us, unless you specify otherwise, you are entered into our consumer database. You may then be added to our list to receive communiques regarding promotional offers, new product and\/or service introductions, industry updates and other news and events you may find interesting. We will not send you junk mailings or any communication unrelated to our business.<\/p>

We make sure to consider and balance any potential impact on you and your rights before we process your personal data for our legitimate interests and do not use your personal data for activities where our interests are overridden by the impact on you (unless we have your consent or are otherwise required or permitted to do so by law). Note that we may process your personal information for more than one lawful ground depending upon the specific purpose for which we are using the data. We will retain your personal data for only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes we collected it for.<\/p>

For more information, see the section titled Choices About How We Use and Disclose Your Information below.<\/p>

Disclosure of Your Information.<\/p>

We may disclose aggregated, non-personal information about our users without restriction.<\/p>

We may disclose personal information that we collect or you provide as described in this privacy policy:<\/p>

To our subsidiaries and affiliates;
To contractors, service providers and other third parties we use to support our business and who are bound by contractual obligations to keep personal information confidential and use it only for the purposes for which we disclose it to them;
To a buyer or other successor in the event of a merger, divestiture, restructuring, reorganization, dissolution or other sale or transfer of some or all of Rainbow International School\u2019s assets, whether as a going concern or as part of bankruptcy, liquidation or similar proceeding, in which personal information held by Rainbow International School about our Websites users is among the assets transferred;
To fulfill the purpose for which you provide it;
For any other purpose disclosed by us when you provide the information; or
With your consent.
We may also disclose your personal information:<\/p>

To comply with any court order, law or legal process, including to respond to any government or regulatory request;
To enforce or apply our Terms of Use (located at [TERMS OF USE LINK<\/a>]) and other agreements, including for billing and collection purposes; or
If we believe disclosure is necessary or appropriate to protect the rights, property, or safety of Rainbow International School, our customers or others.
Choices About How We Use and Disclose Your Information.<\/p>

We strive to provide you with choices regarding the personal information you provide to us. We have created mechanisms to provide you with the following control over your information:<\/p>

Tracking Technologies and Advertising. You can set your browser to refuse all or some browser cookies, or to alert you when cookies are being sent. If you disable or refuse cookies, please note that some parts of this site may then be inaccessible or not function properly.
Communications from Rainbow International School. If you wish to opt-out of receiving any future communication from us, including e-mail, post\/mail, SMS\/text or phone call; and would like to be removed from our database, please send your request to [WEBSITE CONTACT MAIL]. Please include your full contact information including name, company name, complete address, phone number and email. You may also unsubscribe from marketing email by clicking the link at the bottom of the email at any time. This opt out does not apply to information provided to Rainbow International School as a result of a product and\/or service experience or other transactions.
Data Security.<\/p>

Rainbow International School must collect certain information in order to operate the Websites and to fulfill your requests or enable participation in certain online activities. We have implemented reasonable security measure designed to secure the personal information under our control from accidental loss and from unauthorized access, use, alteration and disclosure. We use industry-standard practices, such as encrypted storage and password protection systems, to safeguard the confidentiality of information.<\/p>

Unfortunately, the transmission of information via the internet is not completely secure. Although we do our best to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee the security of your personal information transmitted to our Websites. Any transmission of personal information is at your own risk. We are not responsible for circumvention of any privacy settings or security measures contained on the Websites.<\/p>

Changes to Our Privacy and Cookie Policy.<\/p>

This policy may change from time to time. It is our practice to post any changes we make to our privacy policy on this page. Any changes or updates to the privacy policy are effective immediately upon posting to the Websites and your continued use of the Websites after we make changes is deemed to be acceptance of those changes, so please check the policy periodically for updates. The date the privacy policy was last revised is identified at the bottom of this page. You are responsible for periodically visiting our Websites and this privacy policy to check for any changes.<\/p>

Contact Information.
To ask questions or comment about this privacy policy and our privacy practices, contact us at: admin@rainbowinternationalschool.in.<\/p>

Term of Use

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | Term of Use |

  • Acceptance of the Terms of Use

    The following terms and conditions (these “Terms of Use“), govern your access to and use of the website located at www.rainbowinternationalschool.in and our other websites, including our websites located at other top-level domains or resolving to or linking to or from www.rainbowinternationalschool.in including any content, functionality and services offered on or through such websites (the “Websites“). 

    Please read the Terms of Use carefully before you start to use the Websites. By using the Websites you accept and agree to be bound and abide by these Terms of Use and our Privacy and Cookie Policy, found at [PRIVACY POLICY LINK] incorporated herein by reference. If you do not want to agree to these Terms of Use or the Privacy and Cookie Policy, you must not access or use the Websites. 

    The Websites are offered and available to users who 18 years of age. By using the Websites, you represent and warrant that you meet the foregoing eligibility requirement. If you do not meet this requirement, you must not access or use the Websites.

    Changes to the Terms of Use

    Rainbow International School (“we” or “us“) may revise and update these Terms of Use from time to time in our sole discretion. All changes are effective immediately when we post them, and apply to all access to and use of the Websites thereafter. However, any changes to the dispute resolution provisions set forth in Governing Law and Jurisdiction will not apply to any disputes for which the parties have actual notice on or prior to the date the change is posted on the Websites. 

    Your continued use of the Websites following the posting of revised Terms of Use means that you accept and agree to the changes. You are expected to check this page from time to time so you are aware of any changes, as they are binding on you.

    Accessing the Websites

We will not be liable if for any reason all or any part of the Websites is unavailable at any time or for any period.     To access the Websites or some of the resources they offer, you may be asked to provide certain details or other information. It is a condition of your use of the Websites that all the information you provide on the Websites is correct, current and complete. You agree that all information you provide to the Websites or otherwise, including but not limited to through the use of any interactive features on the Websites, is governed by our Privacy and Cookie Policy [PRIVACY POLICY LINK]  and you consent to all actions we take with respect to your information consistent with our Privacy and Cookie Policy.

Any use of the Website not expressly permitted by these Terms of Use is a breach of these Terms of Use and may violate copyright, trademark and other laws.

    Trademarks

    Prohibited Uses

    You may use the Websites only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms of Use. You agree not to use the content of www.rainbowinternationalschool.in:

    • In any way that violates any applicable federal, state, local or international law or regulation (including, without limitation, any laws regarding the export of data or software to and from India or other countries).

    Information About You and Your Visits to the Websites

If you decide to access any of the third party websites linked to www.rainbowinternationalschool.in, you do so entirely at your own risk and subject to the terms and conditions of use for such websites.

Access to www.rainbowinternationalschool.in may not be legal by certain persons or in certain countries. Career

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | Career | RELATIONSHIP ASSOCIATES

Job Location: Thane/Kalwa

Desired Profile: Graduate with at least 0.6 to 3 years experience in the similar role. Should have flair for Sales as well as post sales activities. Must possess a pleasing personality and excellent communication skills.

Job Description:The incumbent will be responsible for coordination with parents and helping them take a decision for admission. Will have to ensure that enquiries are converted into admissions in the given time frame. Will assist the Branch Head/Chief Admin in carrying out the administrative/operational activities of the branch. BRANCH MANAGER/CHIEF ADMIN

Job Location: Thane/Kalwa

Desired Profile: Graduate /Postgraduate with 5 -10 years of experience in handling overall business operations of a Preschool/School/Educational Institution. Excellent Communication Skills and Pleasing Personality is a must.

Job Description:The incumbent will be responsible for spearheading the overall operations of the branch. Will be leading a team of Admission Counselors, Admin Executives & Support Staff to ensure the smooth functioning of the branch. She will be responsible for delivering the best experience for the kids as well as the parents. She will be accountable for achieving the set revenue targets for the branch. SALES MANAGER

Job Location: Thane/Manpadha

Desired Profile:  Graduate with 5+ years of relevant experience. Provided the candidate is eager to learn and possesses the required skill set. She or He will be responsible for the following:

Job Description:
  • Conceptualizing sales developing activities resulting in revenue generation & resource mobilization.
  • Practical aspects of marketing/sales management: media management printing, event management, marketing/sales plan formulation.
  • Strategizing sales process & suggesting policies to management for growth.
  • Work closely with, and take direction from, Director Sales & Marketing & Board of Directors, and strategize/conceptualize the sales plan as per their thought process.
  • Ideating & strategizing ATL / BTL Activations, tie-ups with coaching classes/educational institutions, Product development through various stages & setting up (Hoardings, Bill Boards, Mall & Multiplex, Digital Marketing, Brand Promotion, Product Launch, Events, Press Launch, Branding through OOH Media, Road Shows, Lead Generation Activities, Vendor Meet, Campaigns, Retail Visibility, etc.).
  • Strategizing Sales plans, Pricing policies & various Sales promotions, Vendor Management
 Expected DOJ: Immediate HR EXECUTIVE RECRUITER

Job Location: Thane

Desired Profile:  Graduate with 2 to 4 years of relevant experience.  Provided the candidate is eager to learn and possesses the required skill set. She or He will be responsible for the following:

Job Description:

 

Job Description of HR Executive Recruiter – 2

  • Filling positions within an organization.
  • Designing and implementing recruiting systems for the organization.
  • Developing own network of suitable candidates.
  • Well versed with all Job Portals
  • Working with organizations to develop a recruitment plan.
  • Executing recruitment plans efficiently.
  • Drafting and posting job descriptions.
  • Interviewing candidates.
  • Networking with various institutions and social media.

 

Expected DOJ: Immediate CONTENT WRITER

Job Location – Thane West 

In this position candidate will be creating content for blogs, articles, service descriptions, social media, and the company website. The content writer’s KPI’s include evaluating analytics to adjust content as needed, regularly updating the company’s website, and promoting the company blog by pitching articles to various third-party platforms. To be successful as a content writer, candidate should keep abreast of the latest SEO techniques & trends.

 Key Responsibilities –

 

  1. Conducting in-depth research on educational industry-related topics in order to develop original & engaging content.
  2. Developing content for blogs, articles, service descriptions, social media, and the company website.
  3. Assisting the digital team in developing content for advertising campaigns.
  4. Proofreading content for errors and inconsistencies.
  5. Editing and polishing existing content to improve readability & Crawling’s.
  6. Conducting keyword research using SEO best practices to increase traffic to the company website or to gather reports from the digital team.
  7. Creating compelling headlines and body copy that will capture the attention of the target audience towards PPC Campaigns & landing pages.
 Key Requirements –

 

  1. Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, English, journalism, or related field.
  2. Proven content writing or copywriting experience with minimum 2-3 years of experience
  3. Working knowledge of content management systems.
  4. Proficient in all Microsoft Office applications & WordPress.
  5. A portfolio of published articles.
  6. Excellent writing and editing skills.
  7. The ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  8. The ability to handle multiple projects concurrently.
  9. Effective communication skills.
FRANCHISEE HEAD

Job Location – Thane West – Rainbow International School, Brahmand

Qualification : any graduate with MBA, preferred from the Education sector

Core functions:

  • Manage the entire franchise sales process from qualification to school opening.
  • Execute the franchise growth strategy for the Company.
  • Increase brand presence, network with lending institutions, enhance prospect flow by networking
  • Recruit new franchisees by attending relevant conventions and tradeshows.
  • Work collaboratively with, legal, IT, accounting, finance, real estate, construction, and franchise operations

Key Duties/responsibility:

Strategic:

  • Develop solid leads, and methodically source and recruit new franchisee prospects to guarantee continual pipeline regeneration.
  • Facilitate New Franchisee Orientation Program.
  • Plan and host corporate Discovery Day events for new franchisee candidates, to display brand superiority.
  • As a part of a site selection committee, review and analyze sites for franchisees
  • Implementation
  • Execute one-on-one sales meetings.
  • Responsible for the franchise sales Pre-qualification and application process.
  • Complete benchmarking to determine some best practice components of the franchise sales industry
MARKETING INTERNS

Job Profile:

  • Visiting various Institutions pertaining to their tie-ups.
  • Visiting various preschools, malls, activity centers, and game zones & understanding their business plans pertaining to their revenue growth.
  • Planning & organizing events for awareness of brand & image positioning in the market.
  • Contributing to the creation of new ideas for social media campaigns & email campaigns.
  • Performing marketing analysis & research along with evaluating competitors marketing materials & digital content.

Requirements:

  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills.
  • Willingness to learn the entire marketing mix cycle.
  • Understanding of Organizational Structure & planning skills.
  • Should be in their final year semester of MBA Marketing & who can work with us on a full-time basis for three to six months during their internship tenure.
  • Candidates who have zeal & flavor for Marketing & Sales are comfortable to go on the field only needs to apply &

      Job Location \u2013 Thane West\u00a0<\/b><\/p>

      In this position candidate will be creating content for blogs, articles, service descriptions, social media, and the company website. The content writer\u2019s KPI\u2019s include evaluating analytics to adjust content as needed, regularly updating the company\u2019s website, and promoting the company blog by pitching articles to various third-party platforms. To be successful as a content writer, candidate should keep abreast of the latest SEO techniques & trends.<\/p>

      \u00a0<\/div>
      Key Responsibilities \u2013
      <\/b>

      \u00a0<\/p>

      1. Conducting in-depth research on educational industry-related topics in order to develop original & engaging content.<\/li>
      2. Developing content for blogs, articles, service descriptions, social media, and the company website.<\/li>
      3. Assisting the digital team in developing content for advertising campaigns.<\/li>
      4. Proofreading content for errors and inconsistencies.<\/li>
      5. Editing and polishing existing content to improve readability & Crawling\u2019s.<\/li>
      6. Conducting keyword research using SEO best practices to increase traffic to the company website or to gather reports from the digital team.<\/li>
      7. Creating compelling headlines and body copy that will capture the attention of the target audience towards PPC Campaigns & landing pages.<\/li><\/ol><\/div>
        \u00a0<\/div>
        Key Requirements \u2013
        <\/b>

        \u00a0<\/p>

        1. Bachelor\u2019s degree in communications, marketing, English, journalism, or related field.<\/li>
        2. Proven content writing or copywriting experience with minimum 2-3 years of experience<\/li>
        3. Working knowledge of content management systems.<\/li>
        4. Proficient in all Microsoft Office applications & WordPress.<\/li>
        5. A portfolio of published articles.<\/li>
        6. Excellent writing and editing skills.<\/li>
        7. The ability to work in a fast-paced environment.<\/li>
        8. The ability to handle multiple projects concurrently.<\/li>
        9. Effective communication skills.<\/li><\/ol><\/div>","_id":"6d8a016"},{"tab_title":"FRANCHISEE HEAD","tab_content":"

CONTENT WRITER

Job Location – Thane West 

In this position candidate will be creating content for blogs, articles, service descriptions, social media, and the company website. The content writer’s KPI’s include evaluating analytics to adjust content as needed, regularly updating the company’s website, and promoting the company blog by pitching articles to various third-party platforms. To be successful as a content writer, candidate should keep abreast of the latest SEO techniques & trends.

 
Key Responsibilities –

 

  1. Conducting in-depth research on educational industry-related topics in order to develop original & engaging content.
  2. Developing content for blogs, articles, service descriptions, social media, and the company website.
  3. Assisting the digital team in developing content for advertising campaigns.
  4. Proofreading content for errors and inconsistencies.
  5. Editing and polishing existing content to improve readability & Crawling’s.

  7. Creating compelling headlines and body copy that will capture the attention of the target audience towards PPC Campaigns & landing pages.
 
Key Requirements –

 

  1. Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, English, journalism, or related field.
  2. Proven content writing or copywriting experience with minimum 2-3 years of experience
  3. Working knowledge of content management systems.
  4. Proficient in all Microsoft Office applications & WordPress.
  5. A portfolio of published articles.
  6. Excellent writing and editing skills.
  7. The ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  8. The ability to handle multiple projects concurrently.
  9. Effective communication skills.

Job Profile:

  • · Visiting various Institutions pertaining to their tie-ups.
  • Visiting various preschools, malls, activity centers, and game zones & understanding their business plans pertaining to their revenue growth.
  • Planning & organizing events for awareness of brand & image positioning in the market.
  • Contributing to the creation of new ideas for social media campaigns & email campaigns.
  • Performing marketing analysis & research along with evaluating competitor’s marketing materials & digital content

Requirements:

  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills.
  • Willingness to learn the entire marketing mix cycle.
  • Understanding of Organizational Structure & planning skills.
  • Should be well versed with MS Office & social media.
  • Freshers who have recently completed their MBA (Marketing) / BMS and have zeal & flavour for Marketing & Sales are comfortable to go on the field only need to apply.
  • Preference would be given to candidates having their own two-wheeler & residing around Thane vicinity.

For trainees whose performance is found good after their selection, the organization would provide them with a sound career progression plan for their overall development.

PR EXECUTIVE

Job Profile:

  • Plan, implement and manage public relations strategies that would reduce existing attrition of customers.
  • Organize PR activities to promote the company’s image by interacting with existing & new clients.
  • Ensuring increase in revenue growth through referral of existing clients.
  • Serves as staff coordinator for public relations and special events developed for the school.
  • Serves as spokesperson for the school division

Requirements:

  • Graduates who have done their courses in PR are preferred.
  • Previous working experience of at least 4 years in Public Relations for educational institutes like schools & colleges
  • Females with pleasing personalities with excellent communication, presentation, and counseling skills only need to apply.
  • Understanding issues of clients, analyzing the root cause for it & taking timely decisions.
  • Being patient & having a calm mind in dealing with clients
SALES & MARKETING HEAD

Job Profile:

  • Sales Functions:
  • Managing practical aspects of sales management including media management, printing, event management, and sales plan formulation.
  • Strategizing sales process & suggesting policies to management for growth.
  • Work closely with the Business Head & Board of Directors, for strategizing/conceptualizing the sales plan as per the business plan.
  • Ideating & strategizing ATL / BTL Activations,tie-ups with coaching classes/educational institutions, Product development through various stages & setting up (Hoardings, Bill Boards, Mall & Multiplex, Digital Marketing, Brand Promotion, Branch Launch, Events, Press Launch, Branding through Outdoor Advertisement, Road Shows, Lead Generation Activities, Vendor Meet, Campaigns, Retail Visibility, etc).
  • Strategizing Sales plans, Pricing policies & various Sales promotions, Vendor Management

Marketing Functions:

  1. a) Marketing Head is responsible for developing, implementing, and executing strategic marketing plans for an entire chain of institutes in order to attract admissions.
  2. b) Planning & meeting the assigned monthly revenue targets with the team members from the entire chain of institutes.
  3. c) Coordinating with the management in the development of marketing programs and strategies for enabling to achieve monthly given admissions & revenue targets.
  4. d) Conceptualizing sales developing activities resulting in revenue generation & resource mobilization.
  5. e) Validating all marketing campaigns including creative inputs for achieving the given targets.
  6. f) Raising the Visibility of the entire chain of institutes by carrying out an effective marketing plan which promotes the profile of the institute as a whole to the external customers.
  7. g) Identifying relevant community-based initiatives in which the institute can play a relevant part to support awareness & building positive brand perception.
  8. h) Develop the whole institute marketing strategy including creating multi-channel communication plans and parent engagement programs to support enrolment growth across the whole institute.

Requirements:

  • Graduate with a minimum of 10 years of experience in Sales & Marketing in the education sector.
  • The candidate should be Presentable and should have the ability to take decisions
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Candidates having their own vehicle would be preferred as travelling within a given territory would be a part of the profile.

Submit Your Resume

item.title: Beyond The Classroom
item.dc:creator: admin_ris
item.content:encoded:
About Rainbow

Rainbow International Rainbow International School | Beyond The Classroom |

Welcome to Rainbow International School

Founded in April 2009, Rainbow International School has touched the lives of more than 25,000 students ever since.

Being One of the Finest educational Institutes in Thane, Rainbow International School is considered to have a campus that spans over 3.5 acres. In addition to being a visible landmark, we are also enormous in terms of many other factors, such as the 3000 students are been enrolled in two shifts.

In addition to being synonymous with quality education, We at Rainbow International School are committed to all-around growth in our students. Rainbow allows its students to explore human excellence through competence, conscience, and compassion.  

Our Teaching methods integrate comfort, colors, and technology within classrooms, which enables our students not only to learn more effectively but also quickly.

We have a diversity of other learning spaces including state of an art laboratories, a library, a multipurpose hall, a music room, a reading room, an infirmary, an organic farming area, and an amphitheater.

Our outdoor spaces for sports activities include - a football field, an adventure sports field, a skating rink, a swimming pool, multipurpose courts, and many more outdoor sporting facilities.

We have been growing in our capacity, in our infrastructure, and in terms of ideas to take better care of our students.

Classes

Chairman’s Note

“Live as if you were to die tomorrow,

Learn as if you were to live forever”

- Mahatma Gandhi

Just like Our Beloved Mahatma Gandhi Ji believed, Learning is absolutely essential for an individual’s growth. Thus when we hear the word Learning, The word Education comes to our mind altogether as they both are co-related.

Education is not only a joint venture but an association between the school and the home but also ensures that children become successful in whatever they choose to pursue. Right education materializes out of cooperation among the learners, mentors, parents, and the community.

At Rainbow, you, the parents, play a vital role in our journey towards excellence and your contribution is priceless to us.

I assure you that the entire team of Rainbow International School helps shape each child into an intelligent, skilled, and committed Indian citizen with a global perspective. I look forward to your kind association, valuable support, and a healthy rapport that shall assist us in the holistic development of each child.

Yours Sincerely,

Mrs Akila Balbale
Chairperson

Our Vision & Mission

Contacts
Vision

We recognize the importance of imparting an educational experience that is of international standards which prepares children for global citizenship. We are a school with an Indian mind and with an Indian soul, a school that celebrates the culture of excellence and nurtures values.

We believe that a national curriculum accompanied by values and life skills is an integral factor in the process of internationalization of values because one can only give what one has within.

Mission

To provide a conducive environment for learning that brings out the best in the students and supports their all-round development. To encourage the joy of learning amongst our students by awakening and illuminating their intellect level in multidimensional ways.

We also educate our students to excel as good human beings so that they can contribute to the advancement of society through creative activities and scholarly talent.

The Rainbow Philosophy

Philosophy of Transcending Academic Standards

Knowledge and learning are meaningless without sensitivity. At Rainbow, we help students think about larger scenarios.

These scenarios include a developing consciousness about:

  • SELF
  • WORLD
  • GENDER, and
  • ENVIRONMENT.

The syllabi and the teaching methodology are guided by our commitment to shaping our future generations in a way that they can handle new challenges creatively.

Amenities & Facilities

Nurturing Green Thinking

Students connect with nature & see how life is born when they sow seeds in the garden.

Asserting Dignity of Labour

Students join in-house community service to appreciate the value of all kinds of work.

Developing Personalities

Students learn about etiquette, social behavior, and ethical ways of thinking and responding.

Emphasizing Gender Sensitivity

Students think about ways to overcome bias & discrimination & nurture a positive self-image

Parents Corner

Explore Parent’s Response box down here.

Good school, caring teachers, extremely supportive staff who put in a lot of effort and the experience has been good for us. It’s always a partnership between Institutions and parents to give the best to children and has therefore worked well for us. keep up the good work teachers and thank you. Mohan Ramaswamy I will recommend this school as this school given up so much in terms of values and well organized.. It was first time I sent my daughter for outstation picnic and beyond expectations it was really very well organized and communication between teachers and parents are always welcome… Management and teachers give ears to share parents point of view!! Ruchi Verma We are very Happy with the school… authorities and the management. Teachers are also nice n ensure all the kids get the required attention. Extra curricular activities are also looked after and appreciated. Ratish Pradhan A Progressive School with Very Supportive Management. Teachers & Support staff are very cooperative. Most Importantly, even if there are any issues School always puts forward an issue resolving approach Alok Srivastava Highly recommended school. Most lively atmosphere. The warmth in the school makes every child comfortable. Lot of extra efforts taken by the management to introduce practical activities for students to get exposed to real challenges in real life. Hygiene their forte .. Undoubtedly the best school in Thane. Anuja Pradhan The study pattern in rainbow is very well balanced between books & extra activity, I love to here from my 8 yrs son when he explains me everything he learnt this means he is enjoying which was not the case one year back when he was in another school. Great going rainbow teachers keep it up. Chandrasekhar Ella Great school… standard of teaching is of very high level…also give preference to personality development… sports day.. picnic… annual day… every event was owsome… well organised & very nicely presented and executed. Hemalata Nigudkar A school where the teachers care for the students like parents do… the place where every child gets equal opportunity & blossoms into a better version of themselves. Students love to come to school as there is never a dull moment… fun & learning go hand in hand 👍🏻👍🏻 Amrapali Koonapareddy My daughter Aarya goes to this school, it is a great school with amazing infrastructure, safety is the most important thing that they have. Teachers are very supportive. The most thing I like that they have their own organic farm where kids learn the things practically. So far very nice experience. My kid enjoy this schooling. Aarya Rahul Desai I would highly recommend Rainbow International School without hesitation. There are so many options locally that it can be overwhelming to choose but RIS gave my child a stellar foundation plus a nurturing environment that made the school an extension of our family. To watch the excellent teachers at Rainbow International School in action is truly a sight! Dhaval Lodaya Went for inquiry session, wonderful infrastructure, strong security arrangement and lovely people to guide. Surely going ahead for admissions. Would strong recommend Rainbow International School. Ravi Thakur Hello…feeling privileged to share my view on this page. Just a word… Fantastic school. The teachers are Professional, caring and well organized.. infrastructure is outstanding. Children grow intellectually as well as in other co Curricular activities… teachers really care & truly want the best for a child… Surabhi Trivedi Rainbow international School nurtures each child’s natural talents & intelligence to help them achieve their full potential, through Academic Excellence, Outstanding coaching for Sports, Best Infrastructure, Personal Attention and Holistic Development. Nikhil Ghavnalkar The school works on nurturing the kids for all-round development & rather than just focusing on academics. Many events are held throughout the year to encourage students to develop their skills in the relevant domain. The school is affiliated with CBSE & maintain the utmost standard of education. Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane. Aabhay Choudhary Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. My son is happy studying in Rainbow International School. My school is in their Anand Nagar Branch. Netra Patil Chatterjee It’s a great educational establishment to entrust your kids too, with an excellent infrastructure and warm-hearted, friendly and cooperative staff. I will recommend Rainbow International School for you kids. Mark D’Souza

Founded in April 2009, Rainbow International School<\/strong> has touched the lives of more than 25,000 students ever since.<\/p>

Being One of the Finest educational Institutes in Thane, Rainbow International School<\/strong> is considered to have a campus that spans over 3.5 acres. In addition to being a visible landmark, we are also enormous in terms of many other factors, such as the 3000 students are been enrolled in two shifts.<\/p>

In addition to being synonymous with quality education, We at Rainbow International School are committed to all-around growth in our students. Rainbow allows its students to explore human excellence through competence, conscience, and compassion.\u00a0\u00a0<\/p>

Our Teaching methods integrate comfort, colors, and technology within classrooms, which enables our students not only to learn more effectively but also quickly.<\/p>

We have a diversity of other learning spaces including state of an art laboratories, a library, a multipurpose hall, a music room, a reading room, an infirmary, an organic farming area, and an amphitheater.<\/p>

Our outdoor spaces for sports activities include - a football field, an adventure sports field, a skating rink, a swimming pool, multipurpose courts, and many more outdoor sporting facilities.<\/p>

We have been growing in our capacity, in our infrastructure, and in terms of ideas to take better care of our Education is not only a joint venture but an association between the school and the home but also ensures that children become successful in whatever they choose to pursue. Right education materializes out of cooperation among the learners, mentors, parents, and the community.<\/p>

At Rainbow, you, the parents, play a vital role in our journey towards excellence and your contribution is priceless to us.<\/p>

I assure you that the entire team of Rainbow International School helps shape each child into an intelligent, skilled, and committed Indian citizen with a global perspective. Good school, caring teachers, extremely supportive staff who put in a lot of effort and the experience has been good for us. It’s always a partnership between Institutions and parents to give the best to children and has therefore worked well for us. keep up the good work teachers and thank you.
Mohan Ramaswamy
I will recommend this school as this school given up so much in terms of values and well organized.. It was first time I sent my daughter for outstation picnic and beyond expectations it was really very well organized and communication between teachers and parents are always welcome… Management and teachers give ears to share parents point of view!!
Ruchi Verma
We are very Happy with the school… authorities and the management. Teachers are also nice n ensure all the kids get the required attention. Extra curricular activities are also looked after and appreciated.
Ratish Pradhan
A Progressive School with Very Supportive Management. Teachers & Support staff are very cooperative. Most Importantly, even if there are any issues School always puts forward an issue resolving approach
Alok Srivastava
Highly recommended school. Most lively atmosphere. The warmth in the school makes every child comfortable. Lot of extra efforts taken by the management to introduce practical activities for students to get exposed to real challenges in real life. Hygiene their forte .. Undoubtedly the best school in Thane.
Anuja Pradhan
The study pattern in rainbow is very well balanced between books & extra activity, I love to here from my 8 yrs son when he explains me everything he learnt this means he is enjoying which was not the case one year back when he was in another school. Great going rainbow teachers keep it up.
Chandrasekhar Ella
Great school… standard of teaching is of very high level…also give preference to personality development… sports day.. picnic… annual day… every event was owsome… well organised & very nicely presented and executed.
Hemalata Nigudkar
A school where the teachers care for the students like parents do… the place where every child gets equal opportunity & blossoms into a better version of themselves. Students love to come to school as there is never a dull moment… fun & learning go hand in hand 👍🏻👍🏻
Amrapali Koonapareddy
My daughter Aarya goes to this school, it is a great school with amazing infrastructure, safety is the most important thing that they have. Teachers are very supportive. The most thing I like that they have their own organic farm where kids learn the things practically. So far very nice experience. My kid enjoy this schooling.
Aarya Rahul Desai
I would highly recommend Rainbow International School without hesitation. There are so many options locally that it can be overwhelming to choose but RIS gave my child a stellar foundation plus a nurturing environment that made the school an extension of our family. To watch the excellent teachers at Rainbow International School in action is truly a sight!
Dhaval Lodaya
Went for inquiry session, wonderful infrastructure, strong security arrangement and lovely people to guide. Surely going ahead for admissions. Would strong recommend Rainbow International School.
Ravi Thakur
Hello…feeling privileged to share my view on this page. Just a word… Fantastic school. The teachers are Professional, caring and well organized.. infrastructure is outstanding. Children grow intellectually as well as in other co Curricular activities… teachers really care & truly want the best for a child…
Surabhi Trivedi
Rainbow international School nurtures each child’s natural talents & intelligence to help them achieve their full potential, through Academic Excellence, Outstanding coaching for Sports, Best Infrastructure, Personal Attention and Holistic Development.
Nikhil Ghavnalkar
The school works on nurturing the kids for all-round development & rather than just focusing on academics. Many events are held throughout the year to encourage students to develop their skills in the relevant domain. The school is affiliated with CBSE & maintain the utmost standard of education. Highly recommended school to choose from. Best school in thane.
Aabhay Choudhary
Awesome school to get Education from. All The teachers are very creative and super supportive. My son is happy studying in Rainbow International School. My school is in their Anand Nagar Branch.
Netra Patil Chatterjee
It’s a great educational establishment to entrust your kids too, with an excellent infrastructure and warm-hearted, friendly and cooperative staff. I will recommend Rainbow International School for you kids.
Mark D’Souza

Send Inquiries
Admissions Open for 24-25

Thanks for Visiting Rainbow International School. Kindly fill the inquiry form to enrol your child at Rainbow International School. Once received, Our Admission Counsellor will connect with you shortly, Thank you!

Rainbow International School, Thane West

Founded in April 2009, Rainbow International School has touched the lives of more than 25,000 students ever since.

Being One of the Finest educational Institutes in Thane, Rainbow International School is considered to have a campus that spans over 3.5 acres. In addition to being a visible landmark, we are also enormous in terms of many other factors, such as the 3000 students are been enrolled in two shifts.

In addition to being synonymous with quality education, We at Rainbow International School are committed to all-around growth in our students. Rainbow allows its students to explore human excellence through competence, conscience, and compassion.  

Our Teaching methods integrate comfort, colors, and technology within classrooms, which enables our students not only to learn more effectively but also quickly.

Nursery | Jr KG | Sr KG

Admission Open

We offer globally recognized educational resources and state-of-the-art facilities that make Rainbow International School the best international school in Thane.

item.title: 7 Safety and Security Measures Your Kids’ School Should Have
item.dc:creator: animamax
item.content:encoded:
Most parents visit the school in order to enquire about the admission procedure and other details like fees. However, they neglect to ask their counsellor at the school about crucial things like safety and security. 

They do not ask questions like:

  • What measures do you have to ensure that our kids are safe at your school?
  • How many security guards do you have?
  • Are they well trained?
  • What are you doing to protect our children from any kind of harm?

The counsellors, on the other hand, focus on what they want the parents to listen to. These include details like:

  • academic affiliation like CBSE or ICSE etc
  • digital resources 
  • qualifications of teachers
  • spacious classrooms
  • fees, books, uniforms

While these details are important, they come at the expense of the most important factor: your kids’ safety and security. What use will be details like academic board and learning tabs if they can’t take care of children?

Here are 7 things you should keep an eye on while going to a school for counselling.

1. CCTV Cameras

CCTV cameras are found everywhere. And for good reason. Because they can help trace the source of the problem. 

When you walk into a school, notice the number of cameras around you. Ask your counsellor questions about how many of these CCTV cameras are working and if they’re used regularly to cross-check anything.

2. Fences

Does the school have well-defined boundaries? Is it easy for any outsider or unauthorized person to walk in?

A fenced campus also helps in keeping children from stepping out of the school.

3. Guarded Entrance

How the security personnel behave at the entrance of the school speaks volumes about the safety measures followed in the school.

Notice if they’re alert.

The entrance is the most obvious point of contact between the students and outsiders. It has got to be well-guarded.

4. ID Cards

ID cards are not meant for torturing students. They’re there for a valid reason: to identify who’s a student and who’s not.

More importantly, students come in uniforms. Grown-ups don’t. 

So the teachers and other staff ought to be have the ID cards too. Because it’s the grown-ups in the school who need to be identified well.

Check how many staff members, teachers or not, are in possession of their ID cards.

5. Security Training

Most schools stop at the regular details of CCTV cameras, fences, security at the gate, and ID cards.

However, the safety and security goes beyond these visible markers.

In order to be called truly safe and secure, an organization should be updated with news sources of threat and new ways to tackle them.

You’ll not be able to see it for yourself in the school but you can ask your counsellor. How well-trained are the security guards?

It helps even more if the students too are made familiar with the security protocols.

6. Security Alarms

When we think of security, the first word to come to mind is the CCTV cameras. However, security alarms are equally important.

Security alarms help alert the entire building if the need arises. The presence of security alarms also shows that the team is well-versed with security methods. 

Because when the alarm rings, depending on the location where the alert has gone off, specific teams are supposed to rush to the scene and the others are expected to cover other areas.

7. Access Cards

If you’re visiting the school, chances are that you’d be given an exclusive visitor’s card, or access card. 

Specially dedicated access cards for outsiders are a sign that the school monitors who’s entering the school, at what time and for what purpose. 

This means that no outsider can step into the school without the knowledge of the security in-charge.

The 7 measures explained above are indicators of how prepared the school is to handle any potential security threats.

Some of these are visible and some you’ll need ask the counsellor for yourself.

While looking for a school, you’ve got to go beyond the obvious. Safety and security are on every parent’s mind. But most people neglect to raise any questions.

The above list of 7 measures will hopefully empower you. 

Do you recall if any of these measures were observed in a school you may visited lately?

item.title: 9 Reasons Why Schools Should Have an Infirmary and Paediatrician
item.dc:creator: animamax
item.content:encoded:
Most schools have first aid and a dedicated ambulance to handle any medical emergencies. An infirmary and a paediatrician are rarely heard of as belonging to the ecosystem of a school. 

When it comes to taking steps towards development of the children, schools pay a lot of attention to their intellectual development. While it is expected that schools take care of the intellectual growth of the students through academics, they also ought to do something about their actual, physical development.

Having a first aid box and an ambulance at disposal isn’t enough. Schools are capable of doing more and ought to do so too. Incorporating an infirmary and a paediatrician, for instance, expands the horizon of the minimum that is expected from a school.

There are 9 reasons why schools should have an infirmary and paediatrician:

  1. No student would like to be packed off to a hospital in an ambulance. No parents would approve of a school sending their children away. Yes, emergencies can happen at any time and a school is expected to be better equipped to handle them.
  1. Transporting children to a hospital takes time. The commute itself may cause serious, further damage to the problem.
  1. Physical well-being is not a matter of exceptional situations. Health is not about an annual check-up of weight, height, dental hygiene, or a nutrition chart.
  1. Health is about everyday practice. In order to inculcate habits of good health, one needs to ensure that there is an environment which pays attention to health everyday. A dedicated infirmary ensures that.
  1. Students are always engaging in sports. They may get hurt and bruised and in some cases, mere first aid is only the first step towards proper treatment.
  1. When students share their food and accidentally eat something they’re allergic to, they need immediate attention.
  1. An infirmary is a dedicated space where students can rest or recover when they need medical attention. Other spaces like classrooms or teachers’ room do not have the right facilities.
  1. In the process of helping so many children battle any health issues, schools can become rich repositories of knowledge, which can in turn, help other pediatricians in the city to get a better understanding of what is happening. This is especially crucial in the case of an epidemic.
  1. Schools become active partners with parents in promoting overall health of children. Parents can rest assured that the schools are doing more than teaching different subjects.

When it comes to doing activities that help students grow better and healthier, sports are not enough. 

Safety and security of children need not be restricted to surveillance equipment. A student, healthy in both body and mind, is the complete responsibility of the school, especially when away from home, and in school premises. 

The best of the schools go beyond having first aid and ambulance basic measures in place to address anything related to physical well-being.

So how many of the schools around you have an infirmary or even a paediatrician?
